+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+]
+
+
+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def copied(src: Path, parent: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest
+
+
+def baseline_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-baseline.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        bc_target = copied(FIX / "skeleton/good_bc/application/orders", td, "bc")
+        file_target = td / "target.py"
+        file_target.write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        nonexistent = td / "does-not-exist"
+        empty = td / "empty"
+        empty.mkdir()
+
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            green_sub = "good_bc" if lane == "skeleton" else "good"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            green = copied(FIX / lane / green_sub, td, f"green-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            cases = [
+                ("red", red, profile, None),
+                ("green", green, profile, None),
+                ("noargs", None, [], empty),
+                ("nonexistent", nonexistent, profile, None),
+                ("file_target", file_target, profile, None),
+                ("bc_shaped", bc_target, profile, None),
+                ("unknown_option", green, [*profile, "--not-a-real-option"], None),
+                ("help", green, ["--help"], None),
+            ]
+            for kind, target, extra, cwd in cases:
+                old = run("old", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                new = run("new", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "baseline", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def record_matrix():
+    valid_changed = []
+    invalid_changed = []
+    old_env_changed = []
+    valid_record_counts = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-record.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        invalid_path = td / "missing-parent" / "records.jsonl"
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")

+            valid_path = td / f"{script}.jsonl"

+                valid_changed.append(script)

+            valid_record_counts[script] = len(valid_path.read_bytes().splitlines()) if valid_path.exists() else 0
+            bad_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, bad_new):
+                invalid_changed.append(script)
+            unset_old = run("old", script, red, profile)
+            set_old = run("old", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_old, set_old):
+                old_env_changed.append(script)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "record",

+            "invalid_path_changed": invalid_changed,
+            "old_env_changed": old_env_changed,

+        }, ensure_ascii=False))

+        emit_diff("representative-old-vs-new-unset", unset_old, unset_new)
+        emit_diff("representative-new-unset-vs-invalid-record", unset_new, bad_new)
+

+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["baseline", "record"])

+    if ns.mode == "baseline":

+    else:
+        record_matrix()

+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path("/Users/hyun/Desktop/dddjango")
+BASE = Path("/tmp/dddjango-r-lane.JyUHO9")
+OLD = BASE / "old"
+NEW = BASE / "new"
+FIX = ROOT / "workspace/eval/fixtures"
+
+REGISTRY = [
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),
+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+]
+
+
+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def copied(src: Path, parent: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest
+
+
+def baseline_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-baseline.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        bc_target = copied(FIX / "skeleton/good_bc/application/orders", td, "bc")
+        file_target = td / "target.py"
+        file_target.write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        nonexistent = td / "does-not-exist"
+        empty = td / "empty"
+        empty.mkdir()
+
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            green_sub = "good_bc" if lane == "skeleton" else "good"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            green = copied(FIX / lane / green_sub, td, f"green-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            cases = [
+                ("red", red, profile, None),
+                ("green", green, profile, None),
+                ("noargs", None, [], empty),
+                ("nonexistent", nonexistent, profile, None),
+                ("file_target", file_target, profile, None),
+                ("bc_shaped", bc_target, profile, None),
+                ("unknown_option", green, [*profile, "--not-a-real-option"], None),
+                ("help", green, ["--help"], None),
+            ]
+            for kind, target, extra, cwd in cases:
+                old = run("old", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                new = run("new", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "baseline", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def record_matrix():
+    valid_changed = []
+    invalid_changed = []
+    old_env_changed = []
+    valid_record_counts = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-record.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        invalid_path = td / "missing-parent" / "records.jsonl"
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            unset_new = run("new", script, red, profile)
+            valid_path = td / f"{script}.jsonl"
+            set_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(valid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, set_new):
+                valid_changed.append(script)
+                emit_diff(f"record-valid:{script}", unset_new, set_new)
+            valid_record_counts[script] = len(valid_path.read_bytes().splitlines()) if valid_path.exists() else 0
+            bad_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, bad_new):
+                invalid_changed.append(script)
+            unset_old = run("old", script, red, profile)
+            set_old = run("old", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_old, set_old):
+                old_env_changed.append(script)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "record",
+            "valid_stdout_stderr_exit_changed": valid_changed,
+            "invalid_path_changed_count": len(invalid_changed),
+            "invalid_path_changed": invalid_changed,
+            "old_env_changed": old_env_changed,
+            "valid_record_counts": valid_record_counts,
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+        script = "check-db-table.py"
+        red = td / f"red-{script}"
+        unset_old = run("old", script, red, [])
+        unset_new = run("new", script, red, [])
+        bad_new = run("new", script, red, [], {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+        emit_diff("representative-old-vs-new-unset", unset_old, unset_new)
+        emit_diff("representative-new-unset-vs-invalid-record", unset_new, bad_new)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["baseline", "record"])
+    ns = parser.parse_args()
+    if ns.mode == "baseline":
+        baseline_matrix()
+    else:
+        record_matrix()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

def _entries(d: Path) -> tuple[list[Path], list[Path]]:
    dirs: list[Path] = []
    files: list[Path] = []
    for p in sorted(d.iterdir()):
        if p.name.startswith(".") or p.name in SKIP_DIRS:
            continue
        (dirs if p.is_dir() else files).append(p)
    return dirs, files

class Findings(list):
    """출력 규약 준수군용 — 라인 "[{rule}] {where}: {msg}" + violation 레코드."""

    def __init__(self, checker: "str | None" = None) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.checker: str = checker or _default_checker()

    def add(self, rule: str, where: "str | Path", msg: str, symbol: "str | None" = None) -> None:
        where_s: str = str(where)  # Path 호출자(B/C형)와 라인 문면·레코드 file 을 한 문자열로 고정
        self.append(f"[{rule}] {where_s}: {msg}")
        _emit(self.checker, rule, where_s, symbol, "violation", msg)


class Candidates(list):
    """ⓓ 후보 채널 — 라인 "[ⓓ{rule}] {where}: {msg} — 물음: {q}" + info 레코드(exit 불산입)."""

    def __init__(self, checker: "str | None" = None) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.checker: str = checker or _default_checker()

    def add(self, rule: str, where: "str | Path", msg: str, question: str,
            symbol: "str | None" = None) -> None:
        where_s: str = str(where)
        self.append(f"[ⓓ{rule}] {where_s}: {msg} — 물음: {question}")
        _emit(self.checker, rule, where_s, symbol, "info", f"{msg} — 물음: {question}")

+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def copied(src: Path, parent: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest
+
+
+def baseline_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-baseline.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        bc_target = copied(FIX / "skeleton/good_bc/application/orders", td, "bc")
+        file_target = td / "target.py"
+        file_target.write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        nonexistent = td / "does-not-exist"
+        empty = td / "empty"
+        empty.mkdir()
+
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            green_sub = "good_bc" if lane == "skeleton" else "good"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            green = copied(FIX / lane / green_sub, td, f"green-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            cases = [
+                ("red", red, profile, None),
+                ("green", green, profile, None),
+                ("noargs", None, [], empty),
+                ("nonexistent", nonexistent, profile, None),
+                ("file_target", file_target, profile, None),
+                ("bc_shaped", bc_target, profile, None),
+                ("unknown_option", green, [*profile, "--not-a-real-option"], None),
+                ("help", green, ["--help"], None),
+            ]
+            for kind, target, extra, cwd in cases:
+                old = run("old", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                new = run("new", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "baseline", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def record_matrix():
+    valid_changed = []
+    invalid_changed = []
+    old_env_changed = []
+    valid_record_counts = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-record.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        invalid_path = td / "missing-parent" / "records.jsonl"
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            unset_new = run("new", script, red, profile)
+            valid_path = td / f"{script}.jsonl"
+            set_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(valid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, set_new):
+                valid_changed.append(script)
+                emit_diff(f"record-valid:{script}", unset_new, set_new)
+            valid_record_counts[script] = len(valid_path.read_bytes().splitlines()) if valid_path.exists() else 0
+            bad_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, bad_new):
+                invalid_changed.append(script)
+            unset_old = run("old", script, red, profile)
+            set_old = run("old", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_old, set_old):
+                old_env_changed.append(script)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "record",
+            "valid_stdout_stderr_exit_changed": valid_changed,
+            "invalid_path_changed_count": len(invalid_changed),
+            "invalid_path_changed": invalid_changed,
+            "old_env_changed": old_env_changed,
+            "valid_record_counts": valid_record_counts,
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+        script = "check-db-table.py"
+        red = td / f"red-{script}"
+        unset_old = run("old", script, red, [])
+        unset_new = run("new", script, red, [])
+        bad_new = run("new", script, red, [], {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+        emit_diff("representative-old-vs-new-unset", unset_old, unset_new)
+        emit_diff("representative-new-unset-vs-invalid-record", unset_new, bad_new)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["baseline", "record"])
+    ns = parser.parse_args()
+    if ns.mode == "baseline":
+        baseline_matrix()
+    else:
+        record_matrix()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def copied(src: Path, parent: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest
+
+
+def baseline_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-baseline.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        bc_target = copied(FIX / "skeleton/good_bc/application/orders", td, "bc")
+        file_target = td / "target.py"
+        file_target.write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        nonexistent = td / "does-not-exist"
+        empty = td / "empty"
+        empty.mkdir()
+
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            green_sub = "good_bc" if lane == "skeleton" else "good"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            green = copied(FIX / lane / green_sub, td, f"green-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            cases = [
+                ("red", red, profile, None),
+                ("green", green, profile, None),
+                ("noargs", None, [], empty),
+                ("nonexistent", nonexistent, profile, None),
+                ("file_target", file_target, profile, None),
+                ("bc_shaped", bc_target, profile, None),
+                ("unknown_option", green, [*profile, "--not-a-real-option"], None),
+                ("help", green, ["--help"], None),
+            ]
+            for kind, target, extra, cwd in cases:
+                old = run("old", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                new = run("new", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "baseline", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def record_matrix():
+    valid_changed = []
+    invalid_changed = []
+    old_env_changed = []
+    valid_record_counts = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-record.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        invalid_path = td / "missing-parent" / "records.jsonl"
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            unset_new = run("new", script, red, profile)
+            valid_path = td / f"{script}.jsonl"
+            set_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(valid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, set_new):
+                valid_changed.append(script)
+                emit_diff(f"record-valid:{script}", unset_new, set_new)
+            valid_record_counts[script] = len(valid_path.read_bytes().splitlines()) if valid_path.exists() else 0
+            bad_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, bad_new):
+                invalid_changed.append(script)
+            unset_old = run("old", script, red, profile)
+            set_old = run("old", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_old, set_old):
+                old_env_changed.append(script)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "record",
+            "valid_stdout_stderr_exit_changed": valid_changed,
+            "invalid_path_changed_count": len(invalid_changed),
+            "invalid_path_changed": invalid_changed,
+            "old_env_changed": old_env_changed,
+            "valid_record_counts": valid_record_counts,
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+        script = "check-db-table.py"
+        red = td / f"red-{script}"
+        unset_old = run("old", script, red, [])
+        unset_new = run("new", script, red, [])
+        bad_new = run("new", script, red, [], {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+        emit_diff("representative-old-vs-new-unset", unset_old, unset_new)
+        emit_diff("representative-new-unset-vs-invalid-record", unset_new, bad_new)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["baseline", "record"])
+    ns = parser.parse_args()
+    if ns.mode == "baseline":
+        baseline_matrix()
+    else:
+        record_matrix()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    try:
        config = _parse_config(argv[1:])
    except UsageError as exc:
        print(f"[check-error-centralization] 사용 오류: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except SystemExit as exc:
        return int(exc.code)

    if config.anchor is not None:
        # 재료 선검증 — 무발견 clean 이라도 resolve 불능 앵커·부재/형식 오류 빚 파일·
        # 공허 차분이 침묵 exit 0 되지 않게 parse 직후 막는다(fail-closed).
        try:
            anchor_diff.validate_materials(config.root, config.anchor, config.anchor_debt_file)
        except anchor_diff.AnchorDiffUsage as exc:
            print(f"[check-error-centralization] 사용 오류: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1

    # 표준 트리 슬라이스 — 프로필과 무관하게 먼저 본다(옛 auto 무동작 = fail-open 차단).
    bcs = _tree_bcs(config.root)
    if not any(
        (bc / d).is_dir() for bc in bcs for d in _TREE_DRIVING
    ) and _tree_adopted(bcs):
        print("[check-error-centralization] blocker: 채택 신호는 있는데 driving 층이 0건이다 — 조용한 무동작을 금지한다(#74)")
        return 2
    # --anchor 미지정이면 현행 그대로 각 슬라이스에서 즉시 exit 2 — 지정 시에만
    # 슬라이스 진단을 모아 마지막에 판정 차분(anchor_diff)으로 exit 를 정한다.
    collected: list[str] = []
    pending_analysis: list[str] = []
    tree_findings = _tree_slice(config.root, bcs)
    if tree_findings:
        print("[check-error-centralization] BLOCKER — BC 오류 스키마 동거 규율 위반 (트리 10행):")
        for f in tree_findings:
            print(f)
        if config.anchor is None:
            return 2
        collected.extend(tree_findings)

    if config.profile not in {None, "auto"}:
        try:
            inventory = _production_inventory(config.root)
            source_paths, code_paths, preserve_paths, plan_analysis, blockers = _source_plan(
                config, inventory
            )
            parsed, source_analysis = _load_sources(config.root, source_paths)
            analysis = [*plan_analysis, *source_analysis]
            findings: list[Finding] = []
            if config.profile == "dddjango-code-json":
                semantic_analysis, findings, blockers = _schema_findings(
                    config,
                    inventory,
                    parsed,
                    code_paths,
                    preserve_paths,
                    blockers,
                )
                analysis.extend(semantic_analysis)
            dynamic_proof_only = bool(analysis) and all(
                issue.startswith("DYNAMIC_ERROR_SHAPE_PROOF_REQUIRED ")
                for issue in analysis
            )
            reported_findings = findings
            if dynamic_proof_only:
                # 정적 error shape 해석에 종속된 판정은 토큰-only 실행에서 억제하고
                # runtime proof 가 대신 검증한다(#15 requires_static_error_shape 동형).
                reported_findings = [
                    finding
                    for finding in findings
                    if not finding.requires_static_error_shape
                ]
            if (reported_findings or blockers) and (not analysis or dynamic_proof_only):
                print(
                    "[check-error-centralization] BLOCKER — code-profile FrameworkErrorSchema schema, "
                    "inventory, or raw code contract violation:"
                )
                # 레코드는 출력 대상과 1:1 거울 — 라인 문면은 blocker/render() 소유 그대로
                # (선행 계약 판형 · rule=null + contract_ref).
                record_findings: ContractFindings = ContractFindings(CONTRACT_REF)
                for blocker in blockers:
                    print(f"  - {blocker}")
                    record_findings.add(f"  - {blocker}", where="(code-profile)", msg=blocker)
                for finding in reported_findings:
                    print(finding.render())
                    record_findings.add(
                        finding.render(),
                        where=f"{finding.relative_path}:{finding.lineno}",
                        msg=f"{finding.category}: {finding.shown}",
                        symbol=finding.category,
                    )
                if dynamic_proof_only:
                    # 토큰 진단을 삼키지 않는다(정보 손실 0) — exit 는 findings 가 정하되,
                    # 남은 정적 해석 불능이 «동적 error shape» 유형임을 함께 보고한다.
                    print(
                        "  (참고 — findings 해소 후 잔여 진단이 아래 토큰뿐이면 exit 1 "
                        "runtime proof 경로가 적용된다:)"
                    )
                    for issue in sorted(set(analysis)):
                        print(f"  - {issue}")
                print(
                    "  근거: common FrameworkErrorSchema는 프로젝트에서 승인한 exact wire shape의 단일 기반이고, 각 BC는 "
                    "canonical ErrorCode/FrameworkErrorSchema hierarchy와 project-wide unique wire code를 소유한다."
                )
                if config.anchor is None:
                    return 2
                collected.extend(f"  - {blocker}" for blocker in blockers)
                collected.extend(finding.render() for finding in reported_findings)
                if dynamic_proof_only:
                    # 토큰-only analysis 는 차분 강등으로 소거되지 않는다 — findings 가
                    # 전건 앵커 기존분이어도 proof 경로(exit 1)로 남긴다(fail-open 차단).
                    pending_analysis = sorted(set(analysis))
            elif analysis:
                raise UsageError("; ".join(sorted(set(analysis))))
        except UsageError as exc:
            print(f"[check-error-centralization] 사용 오류: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1

    if collected:
        try:
            verdict = anchor_diff.partition_exit(
                script=Path(__file__).resolve(),
                label="[check-error-centralization]",
                target=config.root,
                anchor=config.anchor or "",
                argv=argv[1:],
                findings=collected,
                path_flags=frozenset(
                    {
                        "--api-module",
                        "--controller-module",
                        "--project-code-error-module",
                        "--project-preserve-error-module",
                    }
                ),
                debt_file=config.anchor_debt_file,
                analysis_pending=bool(pending_analysis),
            )
        except anchor_diff.AnchorDiffUsage as exc:
            print(f"[check-error-centralization] 사용 오류: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        if verdict == 0 and pending_analysis:
            # 토큰-only analysis 는 강등으로 소거되지 않는다 — proof 경로(exit 1).
            print(
                "[check-error-centralization] 사용 오류: " + "; ".join(pending_analysis),
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 1
        return verdict
    return 0

def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    try:
        config = _parse_config(argv[1:])
    except UsageError as exc:
        print(
            f"[check-api-error-controller-contract] 사용 오류: {exc}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 1
    except SystemExit as exc:
        return int(exc.code)

    if config.anchor is not None:
        # 재료 선검증 — 무발견 clean 이라도 resolve 불능 앵커·부재/형식 오류 빚 파일·
        # 공허 차분이 침묵 exit 0 되지 않게 parse 직후 막는다(fail-closed).
        try:
            anchor_diff.validate_materials(config.root, config.anchor, config.anchor_debt_file)
        except anchor_diff.AnchorDiffUsage as exc:
            print(
                f"[check-api-error-controller-contract] 사용 오류: {exc}",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 1

    # 표준 트리 슬라이스 — 프로필과 무관하게 먼저 본다(옛 auto 무동작 = fail-open 차단).

        print("[check-api-error-controller-contract] blocker: 채택 신호는 있는데 driving 층이 0건이다 — 조용한 무동작을 금지한다(#74)")

                    return 2
                collected.extend(finding.render() for finding in reported_findings)
                # 토큰-only analysis 는 차분 강등으로 소거되지 않는다 — findings 가
                # 전건 앵커 기존분이어도 proof 경로(exit 1)로 남긴다(fail-open 차단).
                pending_analysis = analysis
            elif analysis:
                raise UsageError("; ".join(analysis))
        except UsageError as exc:
            print(
                f"[check-api-error-controller-contract] 사용 오류: {exc}",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 1

    if collected:
        try:
            verdict = anchor_diff.partition_exit(
                script=Path(__file__).resolve(),
                label="[check-api-error-controller-contract]",
                target=config.root,
                anchor=config.anchor or "",
                argv=argv[1:],
                findings=collected,
                path_flags=frozenset({"--api-module", "--controller-module"}),
                debt_file=config.anchor_debt_file,
                analysis_pending=bool(pending_analysis),
            )
        except anchor_diff.AnchorDiffUsage as exc:
            print(
                f"[check-api-error-controller-contract] 사용 오류: {exc}",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 1
        if verdict == 0 and pending_analysis:
            # 토큰-only analysis 는 강등으로 소거되지 않는다 — proof 경로(exit 1).
            print(
                "[check-api-error-controller-contract] 사용 오류: "
                + "; ".join(pending_analysis),
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 1
        return verdict
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))

+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }

+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),

+def same(a, b):

+    }, ensure_ascii=False))

+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest

+def baseline_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-baseline.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        bc_target = copied(FIX / "skeleton/good_bc/application/orders", td, "bc")
+        file_target = td / "target.py"
+        file_target.write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        nonexistent = td / "does-not-exist"
+        empty = td / "empty"
+        empty.mkdir()
+
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            green_sub = "good_bc" if lane == "skeleton" else "good"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            green = copied(FIX / lane / green_sub, td, f"green-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            cases = [
+                ("red", red, profile, None),
+                ("green", green, profile, None),
+                ("noargs", None, [], empty),
+                ("nonexistent", nonexistent, profile, None),
+                ("file_target", file_target, profile, None),
+                ("bc_shaped", bc_target, profile, None),
+                ("unknown_option", green, [*profile, "--not-a-real-option"], None),
+                ("help", green, ["--help"], None),
+            ]
+            for kind, target, extra, cwd in cases:
+                old = run("old", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                new = run("new", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "baseline", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def record_matrix():
+    valid_changed = []
+    invalid_changed = []
+    old_env_changed = []
+    valid_record_counts = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-record.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        invalid_path = td / "missing-parent" / "records.jsonl"
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            unset_new = run("new", script, red, profile)
+            valid_path = td / f"{script}.jsonl"
+            set_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(valid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, set_new):
+                valid_changed.append(script)
+                emit_diff(f"record-valid:{script}", unset_new, set_new)
+            valid_record_counts[script] = len(valid_path.read_bytes().splitlines()) if valid_path.exists() else 0
+            bad_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, bad_new):
+                invalid_changed.append(script)
+            unset_old = run("old", script, red, profile)
+            set_old = run("old", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_old, set_old):
+                old_env_changed.append(script)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "record",
+            "valid_stdout_stderr_exit_changed": valid_changed,
+            "invalid_path_changed_count": len(invalid_changed),
+            "invalid_path_changed": invalid_changed,
+            "old_env_changed": old_env_changed,
+            "valid_record_counts": valid_record_counts,
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+        script = "check-db-table.py"
+        red = td / f"red-{script}"
+        unset_old = run("old", script, red, [])
+        unset_new = run("new", script, red, [])
+        bad_new = run("new", script, red, [], {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+        emit_diff("representative-old-vs-new-unset", unset_old, unset_new)
+        emit_diff("representative-new-unset-vs-invalid-record", unset_new, bad_new)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["baseline", "record"])
+    ns = parser.parse_args()
+    if ns.mode == "baseline":
+        baseline_matrix()
+    else:
+        record_matrix()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import shutil

+NEW = BASE / "new"
+FIX = ROOT / "workspace/eval/fixtures"
+
+REGISTRY = [
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),

+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),

+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def copied(src: Path, parent: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest
+
+
+def baseline_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-baseline.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        bc_target = copied(FIX / "skeleton/good_bc/application/orders", td, "bc")
+        file_target = td / "target.py"
+        file_target.write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        nonexistent = td / "does-not-exist"
+        empty = td / "empty"
+        empty.mkdir()
+
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            green_sub = "good_bc" if lane == "skeleton" else "good"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            green = copied(FIX / lane / green_sub, td, f"green-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            cases = [
+                ("red", red, profile, None),
+                ("green", green, profile, None),
+                ("noargs", None, [], empty),
+                ("nonexistent", nonexistent, profile, None),
+                ("file_target", file_target, profile, None),
+                ("bc_shaped", bc_target, profile, None),
+                ("unknown_option", green, [*profile, "--not-a-real-option"], None),
+                ("help", green, ["--help"], None),
+            ]
+            for kind, target, extra, cwd in cases:
+                old = run("old", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                new = run("new", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "baseline", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def record_matrix():
+    valid_changed = []
+    invalid_changed = []
+    old_env_changed = []
+    valid_record_counts = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-record.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        invalid_path = td / "missing-parent" / "records.jsonl"
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            unset_new = run("new", script, red, profile)
+            valid_path = td / f"{script}.jsonl"
+            set_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(valid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, set_new):
+                valid_changed.append(script)
+                emit_diff(f"record-valid:{script}", unset_new, set_new)
+            valid_record_counts[script] = len(valid_path.read_bytes().splitlines()) if valid_path.exists() else 0
+            bad_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, bad_new):
+                invalid_changed.append(script)
+            unset_old = run("old", script, red, profile)
+            set_old = run("old", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_old, set_old):
+                old_env_changed.append(script)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "record",
+            "valid_stdout_stderr_exit_changed": valid_changed,
+            "invalid_path_changed_count": len(invalid_changed),
+            "invalid_path_changed": invalid_changed,
+            "old_env_changed": old_env_changed,
+            "valid_record_counts": valid_record_counts,
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+        script = "check-db-table.py"
+        red = td / f"red-{script}"
+        unset_old = run("old", script, red, [])
+        unset_new = run("new", script, red, [])
+        bad_new = run("new", script, red, [], {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+        emit_diff("representative-old-vs-new-unset", unset_old, unset_new)
+        emit_diff("representative-new-unset-vs-invalid-record", unset_new, bad_new)
+
+
+def write_tree(root: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+    for rel, source in files.items():
+        path = root / rel
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def compare_cases(cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]], summary: str) -> None:
+    diffs = 0
+    exits: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
+    for label, script, target, extra in cases:
+        old = run("old", script, target, extra)
+        new = run("new", script, target, extra)
+        exits[label] = [old["code"], new["code"]]
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff(label, old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": summary, "comparisons": len(cases), "diffs": diffs, "exits": exits}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+

+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+]
+
+
+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def copied(src: Path, parent: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest
+
+
+def baseline_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-baseline.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        bc_target = copied(FIX / "skeleton/good_bc/application/orders", td, "bc")
+        file_target = td / "target.py"
+        file_target.write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        nonexistent = td / "does-not-exist"
+        empty = td / "empty"
+        empty.mkdir()
+
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            green_sub = "good_bc" if lane == "skeleton" else "good"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            green = copied(FIX / lane / green_sub, td, f"green-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            cases = [
+                ("red", red, profile, None),
+                ("green", green, profile, None),
+                ("noargs", None, [], empty),
+                ("nonexistent", nonexistent, profile, None),
+                ("file_target", file_target, profile, None),
+                ("bc_shaped", bc_target, profile, None),
+                ("unknown_option", green, [*profile, "--not-a-real-option"], None),
+                ("help", green, ["--help"], None),
+            ]
+            for kind, target, extra, cwd in cases:
+                old = run("old", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                new = run("new", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "baseline", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def record_matrix():
+    valid_changed = []
+    invalid_changed = []
+    old_env_changed = []
+    valid_record_counts = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-record.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        invalid_path = td / "missing-parent" / "records.jsonl"
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            unset_new = run("new", script, red, profile)
+            valid_path = td / f"{script}.jsonl"
+            set_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(valid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, set_new):
+                valid_changed.append(script)
+                emit_diff(f"record-valid:{script}", unset_new, set_new)
+            valid_record_counts[script] = len(valid_path.read_bytes().splitlines()) if valid_path.exists() else 0
+            bad_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, bad_new):
+                invalid_changed.append(script)
+            unset_old = run("old", script, red, profile)
+            set_old = run("old", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_old, set_old):
+                old_env_changed.append(script)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "record",
+            "valid_stdout_stderr_exit_changed": valid_changed,
+            "invalid_path_changed_count": len(invalid_changed),
+            "invalid_path_changed": invalid_changed,
+            "old_env_changed": old_env_changed,
+            "valid_record_counts": valid_record_counts,
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+        script = "check-db-table.py"
+        red = td / f"red-{script}"
+        unset_old = run("old", script, red, [])
+        unset_new = run("new", script, red, [])
+        bad_new = run("new", script, red, [], {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+        emit_diff("representative-old-vs-new-unset", unset_old, unset_new)
+        emit_diff("representative-new-unset-vs-invalid-record", unset_new, bad_new)
+
+
+def write_tree(root: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+    for rel, source in files.items():
+        path = root / rel
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def compare_cases(cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]], summary: str) -> None:
+    diffs = 0
+    exits: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
+    for label, script, target, extra in cases:
+        old = run("old", script, target, extra)
+        new = run("new", script, target, extra)
+        exits[label] = [old["code"], new["code"]]
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff(label, old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": summary, "comparisons": len(cases), "diffs": diffs, "exits": exits}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def profile_matrix():
+    common_src = (
+        "from ninja import Schema\n\n"
+        "class FrameworkErrorSchema(Schema):\n"
+        "    code: str\n    title: str\n    status: int\n    detail: str\n"
+    )
+    lesson_src = (
+        "from enum import StrEnum\n"
+        "from framework.ninja.framework_error_schema import FrameworkErrorSchema\n\n"
+        "class LessonErrorCode(StrEnum):\n"
+        "    NOT_FOUND = 'lesson_not_found'\n\n"
+        "class LessonErrorSchema(FrameworkErrorSchema):\n"
+        "    code: LessonErrorCode\n\n"
+        "class LessonNotFoundError(LessonErrorSchema):\n"
+        "    code: LessonErrorCode = LessonErrorCode.NOT_FOUND\n"
+        "    title: str = 'Lesson not found'\n"
+        "    status: int = 404\n"
+        "    detail: str = 'The lesson does not exist.'\n"
+    )
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-profiles.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        api_tree = td / "api-tree"
+        write_tree(api_tree, {
+            "framework/ninja/framework_error_schema.py": common_src,
+            "application/lesson/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py": lesson_src,
+            "application/lesson/driving_layer/controller.py": (
+                "from application.lesson.driving_layer.api.bc_error_schema import LessonNotFoundError\n"
+                "def get_lesson(request):\n    return {'id': 1}\n"
+            ),
+            "config/api.py": "from ninja_extra import NinjaExtraAPI\napi = NinjaExtraAPI()\n",
+        })
+        cent_code = [
+            "--error-profile", "dddjango-code-json", "--scope", "public-v1",
+            "--api-module", "config/api.py",
+            "--controller-module", "application/lesson/driving_layer/controller.py",
+            "--scope-bc", "lesson", "--error-bc", "lesson",
+            "--project-code-error-module", "framework/ninja/framework_error_schema.py",
+            "--project-code-error-module", "application/lesson/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py",
+        ]
+        preserve = [
+            "--error-profile", "preserve-established", "--scope", "public-v1",
+            "--api-module", "config/api.py",
+            "--controller-module", "application/lesson/driving_layer/controller.py",
+            "--scope-bc", "lesson", "--error-bc", "lesson",
+        ]
+        cent_preserve = [*preserve,
+            "--project-preserve-error-module", "application/lesson/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py"]
+        api_code = ["dddjango-code-json" if token == "preserve-established" else token for token in preserve]
+        comp = copied(FIX / "composition_selector/bad_rules", td, "composition")
+        response = copied(FIX / "response_schema_bypass/bad_rules", td, "response")
+        response_controller = "application/orders/driving_layer/api/order/order_controller.py"
+        comp_code = [
+            "--error-profile", "dddjango-code-json", "--scope", "public-v1",
+            "--api-module", "config/api.py", "--urlconf-module", "config/urls.py",
+            "--registrar-module", "application/lesson/driving_layer/api/api_router.py",
+        ]
+        comp_preserve_min = [
+            "--error-profile", "preserve-established", "--scope", "public-v1",
+            "--api-module", "config/api.py",
+        ]
+        comp_preserve_full = [*comp_preserve_min,
+            "--urlconf-module", "config/urls.py",
+            "--registrar-module", "application/lesson/driving_layer/api/api_router.py",
+        ]
+        cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]] = []
+        for script in (
+            "check-error-centralization.py",
+            "check-openapi-error-declaration.py",
+            "check-api-error-controller-contract.py",
+        ):
+            cases.extend([
+                (f"{script}:auto", script, api_tree, ["--error-profile", "auto"]),
+                (f"{script}:invalid-profile", script, api_tree, ["--error-profile", "bogus"]),
+                (f"{script}:duplicate-profile", script, api_tree, ["--error-profile", "auto", "--error-profile", "auto"]),
+                (f"{script}:auto-plus-selector", script, api_tree, ["--error-profile", "auto", "--scope", "x"]),
+                (f"{script}:selector-no-profile", script, api_tree, ["--scope", "x"]),
+                (f"{script}:preserve-valid", script, api_tree, cent_preserve if script.endswith("centralization.py") else preserve),
+                (f"{script}:code-valid", script, api_tree, cent_code if script.endswith("centralization.py") else api_code),
+                (f"{script}:bad-scope-bc", script, api_tree, [*preserve, "--scope-bc", "Bad-BC"]),
+                (f"{script}:error-not-subset", script, api_tree, [*preserve, "--error-bc", "other"]),
+                (f"{script}:duplicate-controller", script, api_tree, [*preserve, "--controller-module", "application/lesson/driving_layer/controller.py"]),
+                (f"{script}:missing-controller", script, api_tree, [*preserve[:-4], "--controller-module", "application/missing/controller.py", "--scope-bc", "lesson"]),
+                (f"{script}:absolute-api", script, api_tree, [*preserve, "--api-module", str(api_tree / "config/api.py")]),
+            ])
+        cases.extend([
+            ("composition:auto", "check-composition-root.py", comp, ["--error-profile", "auto"]),
+            ("composition:invalid", "check-composition-root.py", comp, ["--error-profile", "bogus"]),
+            ("composition:selector-no-profile", "check-composition-root.py", comp, ["--scope", "x"]),
+            ("composition:code", "check-composition-root.py", comp, comp_code),
+            ("composition:preserve-min", "check-composition-root.py", comp, comp_preserve_min),
+            ("composition:preserve-full", "check-composition-root.py", comp, comp_preserve_full),
+            ("composition:preserve-half-pair", "check-composition-root.py", comp, [*comp_preserve_min, "--urlconf-module", "config/urls.py"]),
+            ("composition:duplicate-registrar", "check-composition-root.py", comp, [*comp_code, "--registrar-module", "application/lesson/driving_layer/api/api_router.py"]),
+            ("composition:two-registrars", "check-composition-root.py", comp, [*comp_code, "--registrar-module", "application/catalog/driving_layer/api/api_router.py"]),
+            ("composition:overlap-role", "check-composition-root.py", comp, [*comp_code, "--api-module", "application/lesson/driving_layer/api/api_router.py"]),
+            ("response:selected", "check-response-schema-bypass.py", response, ["--controller-module", response_controller]),
+            ("response:duplicate", "check-response-schema-bypass.py", response, ["--controller-module", response_controller, "--controller-module", response_controller]),
+            ("response:missing", "check-response-schema-bypass.py", response, ["--controller-module", "application/missing/controller.py"]),
+            ("response:absolute", "check-response-schema-bypass.py", response, ["--controller-module", str(response / response_controller)]),
+            ("response:backslash", "check-response-schema-bypass.py", response, ["--controller-module", response_controller.replace("/", "\\")]),
+        ])
+        compare_cases(cases, "profiles")
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["baseline", "record", "profiles"])
+    ns = parser.parse_args()
+    if ns.mode == "baseline":
+        baseline_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "record":
+        record_matrix()
+    else:
+        profile_matrix()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+                valid_changed.append(script)
+                emit_diff(f"record-valid:{script}", unset_new, set_new)
+            valid_record_counts[script] = len(valid_path.read_bytes().splitlines()) if valid_path.exists() else 0
+            bad_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, bad_new):
+                invalid_changed.append(script)
+            unset_old = run("old", script, red, profile)
+            set_old = run("old", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_old, set_old):
+                old_env_changed.append(script)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "record",
+            "valid_stdout_stderr_exit_changed": valid_changed,
+            "invalid_path_changed_count": len(invalid_changed),
+            "invalid_path_changed": invalid_changed,
+            "old_env_changed": old_env_changed,
+            "valid_record_counts": valid_record_counts,
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+        script = "check-db-table.py"
+        red = td / f"red-{script}"
+        unset_old = run("old", script, red, [])
+        unset_new = run("new", script, red, [])
+        bad_new = run("new", script, red, [], {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+        emit_diff("representative-old-vs-new-unset", unset_old, unset_new)
+        emit_diff("representative-new-unset-vs-invalid-record", unset_new, bad_new)
+
+
+def write_tree(root: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+    for rel, source in files.items():
+        path = root / rel
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def compare_cases(cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]], summary: str) -> None:
+    diffs = 0
+    exits: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
+    for label, script, target, extra in cases:
+        old = run("old", script, target, extra)
+        new = run("new", script, target, extra)
+        exits[label] = [old["code"], new["code"]]
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff(label, old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": summary, "comparisons": len(cases), "diffs": diffs, "exits": exits}, ensure_ascii=False))
+

+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+

+        path = root / rel
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")

+def compare_cases(cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]], summary: str) -> None:
+    diffs = 0
+    exits: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
+    for label, script, target, extra in cases:
+        old = run("old", script, target, extra)
+        new = run("new", script, target, extra)
+        exits[label] = [old["code"], new["code"]]

+            emit_diff(label, old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": summary, "comparisons": len(cases), "diffs": diffs, "exits": exits}, ensure_ascii=False))

+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["baseline", "record", "profiles"])

+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def copied(src: Path, parent: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest
+
+
+def baseline_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-baseline.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        bc_target = copied(FIX / "skeleton/good_bc/application/orders", td, "bc")
+        file_target = td / "target.py"
+        file_target.write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        nonexistent = td / "does-not-exist"
+        empty = td / "empty"
+        empty.mkdir()
+
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            green_sub = "good_bc" if lane == "skeleton" else "good"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            green = copied(FIX / lane / green_sub, td, f"green-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            cases = [
+                ("red", red, profile, None),
+                ("green", green, profile, None),
+                ("noargs", None, [], empty),
+                ("nonexistent", nonexistent, profile, None),
+                ("file_target", file_target, profile, None),
+                ("bc_shaped", bc_target, profile, None),
+                ("unknown_option", green, [*profile, "--not-a-real-option"], None),
+                ("help", green, ["--help"], None),
+            ]
+            for kind, target, extra, cwd in cases:
+                old = run("old", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                new = run("new", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "baseline", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def record_matrix():
+    valid_changed = []
+    invalid_changed = []
+    old_env_changed = []
+    valid_record_counts = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-record.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        invalid_path = td / "missing-parent" / "records.jsonl"
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            unset_new = run("new", script, red, profile)
+            valid_path = td / f"{script}.jsonl"
+            set_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(valid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, set_new):
+                valid_changed.append(script)
+                emit_diff(f"record-valid:{script}", unset_new, set_new)
+            valid_record_counts[script] = len(valid_path.read_bytes().splitlines()) if valid_path.exists() else 0
+            bad_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, bad_new):
+                invalid_changed.append(script)
+            unset_old = run("old", script, red, profile)
+            set_old = run("old", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_old, set_old):
+                old_env_changed.append(script)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "record",
+            "valid_stdout_stderr_exit_changed": valid_changed,
+            "invalid_path_changed_count": len(invalid_changed),
+            "invalid_path_changed": invalid_changed,
+            "old_env_changed": old_env_changed,
+            "valid_record_counts": valid_record_counts,
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+        script = "check-db-table.py"
+        red = td / f"red-{script}"
+        unset_old = run("old", script, red, [])
+        unset_new = run("new", script, red, [])
+        bad_new = run("new", script, red, [], {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+        emit_diff("representative-old-vs-new-unset", unset_old, unset_new)
+        emit_diff("representative-new-unset-vs-invalid-record", unset_new, bad_new)
+
+
+def write_tree(root: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+    for rel, source in files.items():
+        path = root / rel
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def compare_cases(cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]], summary: str) -> None:
+    diffs = 0
+    exits: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
+    for label, script, target, extra in cases:
+        old = run("old", script, target, extra)
+        new = run("new", script, target, extra)
+        exits[label] = [old["code"], new["code"]]
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff(label, old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": summary, "comparisons": len(cases), "diffs": diffs, "exits": exits}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
