+GIT_ID = ["-c", "user.email=r-lane@example.invalid", "-c", "user.name=R Lane"]
+
+
+def git(repo: Path, *args: str):
+    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *GIT_ID, *args], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+
+
+def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
+    for args in (("add", "-A"), ("commit", "-q", "-m", message)):
+        proc = git(repo, *args)
+        if proc.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.decode().strip()
+
+
+def init_repo(dest: Path, source: Path) -> tuple[Path, str]:
+    shutil.copytree(source, dest)
+    proc = git(dest, "init", "-q")
+    if proc.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return dest, commit_all(dest, "anchor")
+
+
+def anchor_matrix():
+    specs = [
+        ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+        ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+        ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+        ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+        ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ]
+    cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]] = []
+    anchor_record = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-anchor.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for script, auto, lane in specs:
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            # bogus resolve on a clean green repository.
+            green_repo, _ = init_repo(td / f"bogus-{script}", FIX / lane / "good")
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-bogus", script, green_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", "deadbeef"]))
+            # vacuous diff: HEAD and clean.
+            vac_repo, vac_head = init_repo(td / f"vacuous-{script}", FIX / lane / "bad_rules")
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-vacuous", script, vac_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", vac_head]))
+            # all findings already at anchor; harmless dirty file makes diff non-vacuous.
+            existing_repo, existing_head = init_repo(td / f"existing-{script}", FIX / lane / "bad_rules")
+            (existing_repo / "harmless.txt").write_text("dirty\n", encoding="utf-8")
+            existing_args = [*profile, "--anchor", existing_head]
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-existing", script, existing_repo, existing_args))
+            # red material copied after green anchor: new findings.
+            new_repo, new_head = init_repo(td / f"new-{script}", FIX / lane / "good")
+            shutil.copytree(FIX / lane / "bad_rules", new_repo, dirs_exist_ok=True)
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-new", script, new_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", new_head]))
+
+            # DJR channel is inherited by the baseline child. Compare output and count inflation.
+            plain_rec = td / f"plain-{script}.jsonl"
+            anchor_rec = td / f"anchor-{script}.jsonl"
+            plain = run("new", script, existing_repo, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(plain_rec)})
+            anchored = run("new", script, existing_repo, existing_args, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(anchor_rec)})
+            anchor_record[script] = {
+                "output_same_as_unset": same(run("new", script, existing_repo, existing_args), anchored),
+                "plain_count": len(plain_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()) if plain_rec.exists() else 0,
+                "anchor_count": len(anchor_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()) if anchor_rec.exists() else 0,
+                "plain_exit": plain["code"],
+                "anchor_exit": anchored["code"],
+            }
+
+        # analysis_pending=True: an anchor-existing tree finding plus dynamic error shape proof.
+        analysis_repo = td / "analysis-pending"
+        common_src = (
+            "from ninja import Schema\n\nclass FrameworkErrorSchema(Schema):\n"
+            "    code: str\n    title: str\n    status: int\n    detail: str\n"
+        )
+        dynamic_src = (
+            "from enum import StrEnum\n"
+            "from framework.ninja.framework_error_schema import FrameworkErrorSchema\n\n"
+            "_BASE = 'lesson'\n"
+            "class LessonErrorCode(StrEnum):\n"
+            "    _ignore_ = ['_BASE']\n"
+            "    _BASE = _BASE\n"
+            "    NOT_FOUND = f'{_BASE}_not_found'\n\n"
+            "class LessonErrorSchema(FrameworkErrorSchema):\n    code: LessonErrorCode\n"
+        )
+        write_tree(analysis_repo, {
+            "framework/ninja/framework_error_schema.py": common_src,
+            "application/lesson/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py": dynamic_src,
+            "application/lesson/driving_layer/controller.py": "def get_lesson(request): return {'id': 1}\n",
+            "application/report/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py": "",
+            "config/api.py": "from ninja_extra import NinjaExtraAPI\napi = NinjaExtraAPI()\n",
+        })
+        proc = git(analysis_repo, "init", "-q")
+        if proc.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+        analysis_head = commit_all(analysis_repo, "dynamic anchor")
+        (analysis_repo / "harmless.txt").write_text("dirty\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        analysis_args = [
+            "--error-profile", "dddjango-code-json", "--scope", "public-v1",
+            "--api-module", "config/api.py",
+            "--controller-module", "application/lesson/driving_layer/controller.py",
+            "--scope-bc", "lesson", "--error-bc", "lesson",
+            "--project-code-error-module", "framework/ninja/framework_error_schema.py",
+            "--project-code-error-module", "application/lesson/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py",
+            "--anchor", analysis_head,
+        ]
+        cases.append(("error-centralization:anchor-analysis-pending", "check-error-centralization.py", analysis_repo, analysis_args))
+
+        compare_cases(cases, "anchor")
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "anchor-record-inheritance", "rows": anchor_record}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def run_limited(script: str, target: Path, extra: list[str], env_add: dict[str, str], limit: int):
+    script_path = NEW / script
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    env.update(env_add)
+    def limit_fds():
+        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, (limit, limit))
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(script_path), str(target), *extra],
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, preexec_fn=limit_fds,
+    )
+    return {"code": proc.returncode, "stdout": proc.stdout, "stderr": proc.stderr, "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start}
+
+
+def performance_probe():
+    count = 8000
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-perf.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        target = td / "fixture"
+        controller = target / "application/orders/driving_layer/api/order/order_controller.py"
+        controller.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        (target / "application/orders/application_layer/order").mkdir(parents=True)
+        chunks = []
+        for i in range(count):
+            chunks.append(
+                f"def operation_{i}():\n"
+                "    try:\n        pass\n"
+                "    except Exception:\n        pass\n\n"
+            )
+        controller.write_text("".join(chunks), encoding="utf-8")
+        extra = ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+        measurements: dict[str, list[float]] = {"old-unset": [], "new-unset": [], "new-devnull": [], "new-file": []}
+        codes = {}
+        for round_no in range(4):
+            rec = td / f"records-{round_no}.jsonl"
+            variants = [
+                ("old-unset", lambda: run("old", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra)),
+                ("new-unset", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra)),
+                ("new-devnull", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": "/dev/null"})),
+                ("new-file", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(rec)})),
+            ]
+            # Rotate start position to reduce fixed ordering bias.
+            variants = variants[round_no:] + variants[:round_no]
+            for label, thunk in variants:
+                result = thunk()
+                measurements[label].append(result["elapsed"])
+                codes[label] = result["code"]
+        medians = {label: sorted(values)[len(values)//2] for label, values in measurements.items()}
+        limited_rec = td / "limited.jsonl"
+        limited = run_limited(
+            "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra,
+            {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(limited_rec)}, 16,
+        )
+        last_rec = td / "records-3.jsonl"
+        # round rotation means records-3 may or may not be last, but is written exactly once.
+        summary = {
+            "summary": "performance",
+            "findings": count,
+            "source_bytes": controller.stat().st_size,
+            "samples": {k: [round(x, 4) for x in v] for k, v in measurements.items()},
+            "medians": {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in medians.items()},
+            "file_vs_unset_ratio": round(medians["new-file"] / medians["new-unset"], 3),
+            "new_unset_vs_old_ratio": round(medians["new-unset"] / medians["old-unset"], 3),
+            "codes": codes,
+            "record_lines": len(last_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()),
+            "record_bytes": last_rec.stat().st_size,
+            "fd_limit_16": {"code": limited["code"], "stderr_n": len(limited["stderr"]), "record_lines": len(limited_rec.read_bytes().splitlines())},
+        }
+        print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["baseline", "record", "profiles", "errors", "paths", "anchor", "performance"])
+    ns = parser.parse_args()
+    if ns.mode == "baseline":
+        baseline_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "record":
+        record_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "profiles":
+        profile_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "errors":
+        error_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "paths":
+        path_contract()
+    elif ns.mode == "anchor":
+        anchor_matrix()
+    else:
+        performance_probe()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def copied(src: Path, parent: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest
+
+
+def baseline_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-baseline.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        bc_target = copied(FIX / "skeleton/good_bc/application/orders", td, "bc")
+        file_target = td / "target.py"
+        file_target.write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        nonexistent = td / "does-not-exist"
+        empty = td / "empty"
+        empty.mkdir()
+
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            green_sub = "good_bc" if lane == "skeleton" else "good"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            green = copied(FIX / lane / green_sub, td, f"green-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            cases = [
+                ("red", red, profile, None),
+                ("green", green, profile, None),
+                ("noargs", None, [], empty),
+                ("nonexistent", nonexistent, profile, None),
+                ("file_target", file_target, profile, None),
+                ("bc_shaped", bc_target, profile, None),
+                ("unknown_option", green, [*profile, "--not-a-real-option"], None),
+                ("help", green, ["--help"], None),
+            ]
+            for kind, target, extra, cwd in cases:
+                old = run("old", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                new = run("new", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "baseline", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def record_matrix():
+    valid_changed = []
+    invalid_changed = []
+    old_env_changed = []
+    valid_record_counts = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-record.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        invalid_path = td / "missing-parent" / "records.jsonl"
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            unset_new = run("new", script, red, profile)
+            valid_path = td / f"{script}.jsonl"
+            set_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(valid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, set_new):
+                valid_changed.append(script)
+                emit_diff(f"record-valid:{script}", unset_new, set_new)
+            valid_record_counts[script] = len(valid_path.read_bytes().splitlines()) if valid_path.exists() else 0
+            bad_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, bad_new):
+                invalid_changed.append(script)
+            unset_old = run("old", script, red, profile)
+            set_old = run("old", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_old, set_old):
+                old_env_changed.append(script)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "record",
+            "valid_stdout_stderr_exit_changed": valid_changed,
+            "invalid_path_changed_count": len(invalid_changed),
+            "invalid_path_changed": invalid_changed,
+            "old_env_changed": old_env_changed,
+            "valid_record_counts": valid_record_counts,
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+        script = "check-db-table.py"
+        red = td / f"red-{script}"
+        unset_old = run("old", script, red, [])
+        unset_new = run("new", script, red, [])
+        bad_new = run("new", script, red, [], {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+        emit_diff("representative-old-vs-new-unset", unset_old, unset_new)
+        emit_diff("representative-new-unset-vs-invalid-record", unset_new, bad_new)
+
+
+def write_tree(root: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+    for rel, source in files.items():
+        path = root / rel
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def compare_cases(cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]], summary: str) -> None:
+    diffs = 0
+    exits: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
+    for label, script, target, extra in cases:
+        old = run("old", script, target, extra)
+        new = run("new", script, target, extra)
+        exits[label] = [old["code"], new["code"]]
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff(label, old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": summary, "comparisons": len(cases), "diffs": diffs, "exits": exits}, ensure_ascii=False))
+

+def error_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-errors.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            source = FIX / lane / red_sub
+            for kind in ("syntax", "invalid_utf8", "unreadable_file", "unreadable_dir"):
+                target = copied(source, td, f"{kind}-{script}")
+                files = sorted(target.rglob("*.py"))
+                if not files:
+                    continue
+                chosen = files[0]
+                restore: Path | None = None
+                if kind == "syntax":
+                    chosen.write_text("def broken(:\n", encoding="utf-8")
+                elif kind == "invalid_utf8":
+                    chosen.write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\x00")
+                elif kind == "unreadable_file":
+                    chosen.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen
+                else:
+                    chosen.parent.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen.parent
+                try:
+                    old = run("old", script, target, profile)
+                    new = run("new", script, target, profile)
+                finally:
+                    if restore is not None:
+                        restore.chmod(0o755 if restore.is_dir() else 0o644)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "errors", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def load_module(path: Path, name: str):
+    previous = list(sys.path)
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(path.parent))
+    try:
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+        assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        sys.modules[name] = module
+        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+        return module
+    finally:
+        sys.path[:] = previous
+
+
+def path_contract():
+    os.environ.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    old_mod = load_module(OLD / "check-db-table.py", "old_db_table_probe")
+    new_mod = load_module(NEW / "findings.py", "new_findings_probe")
+    from pathlib import PureWindowsPath
+    values = [
+        Path("application/orders/models.py"),
+        Path("../relative/with space.py"),
+        Path("/tmp/absolute/models.py"),
+        Path(r"application\\orders\\models.py"),
+        PureWindowsPath(r"C:\\repo\\application\\orders\\models.py"),
+        Path("application/orders/model.py:27"),
+    ]
+    rows = []
+    for value in values:
+        old_f = old_mod.Findings()
+        old_f.add("#1", value, "message")
+        new_f = new_mod.Findings("check-db-table.py")
+        new_f.add("#1", value, "message")
+        rows.append({"input": repr(value), "old": list(old_f), "new": list(new_f), "same": list(old_f) == list(new_f)})
+    # Actual checker calls through Path values, with absolute and relative TARGET spelling.
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-paths.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        target = copied(FIX / "db_table/bad_rules", td, "fixture with space")
+        actual = []
+        for label, target_arg, cwd in (
+            ("absolute-target", target, None),
+            ("relative-target", Path("fixture with space"), td),
+        ):
+            old = run("old", "check-db-table.py", target_arg, [], cwd=cwd)
+            new = run("new", "check-db-table.py", target_arg, [], cwd=cwd)
+            actual.append({"label": label, "same": same(old, new), "old": describe(old), "new": describe(new)})
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": "path-contract", "direct": rows, "actual": actual}, ensure_ascii=False))

+GIT_ID = ["-c", "user.email=r-lane@example.invalid", "-c", "user.name=R Lane"]
+
+
+def git(repo: Path, *args: str):
+    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *GIT_ID, *args], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+
+
+def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
+    for args in (("add", "-A"), ("commit", "-q", "-m", message)):
+        proc = git(repo, *args)
+        if proc.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.decode().strip()
+
+
+def init_repo(dest: Path, source: Path) -> tuple[Path, str]:
+    shutil.copytree(source, dest)
+    proc = git(dest, "init", "-q")
+    if proc.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return dest, commit_all(dest, "anchor")
+
+
+def anchor_matrix():
+    specs = [
+        ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+        ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+        ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+        ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+        ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ]
+    cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]] = []
+    anchor_record = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-anchor.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for script, auto, lane in specs:
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            # bogus resolve on a clean green repository.
+            green_repo, _ = init_repo(td / f"bogus-{script}", FIX / lane / "good")
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-bogus", script, green_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", "deadbeef"]))
+            # vacuous diff: HEAD and clean.
+            vac_repo, vac_head = init_repo(td / f"vacuous-{script}", FIX / lane / "bad_rules")
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-vacuous", script, vac_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", vac_head]))
+            # all findings already at anchor; harmless dirty file makes diff non-vacuous.
+            existing_repo, existing_head = init_repo(td / f"existing-{script}", FIX / lane / "bad_rules")
+            (existing_repo / "harmless.txt").write_text("dirty\n", encoding="utf-8")
+            existing_args = [*profile, "--anchor", existing_head]
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-existing", script, existing_repo, existing_args))
+            # red material copied after green anchor: new findings.
+            new_repo, new_head = init_repo(td / f"new-{script}", FIX / lane / "good")
+            shutil.copytree(FIX / lane / "bad_rules", new_repo, dirs_exist_ok=True)
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-new", script, new_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", new_head]))
+
+            # DJR channel is inherited by the baseline child. Compare output and count inflation.
+            plain_rec = td / f"plain-{script}.jsonl"
+            anchor_rec = td / f"anchor-{script}.jsonl"
+            plain = run("new", script, existing_repo, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(plain_rec)})
+            anchored = run("new", script, existing_repo, existing_args, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(anchor_rec)})
+            anchor_record[script] = {
+                "output_same_as_unset": same(run("new", script, existing_repo, existing_args), anchored),
+                "plain_count": len(plain_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()) if plain_rec.exists() else 0,
+                "anchor_count": len(anchor_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()) if anchor_rec.exists() else 0,
+                "plain_exit": plain["code"],
+                "anchor_exit": anchored["code"],
+            }
+
+        # analysis_pending=True: an anchor-existing tree finding plus dynamic error shape proof.
+        analysis_repo = td / "analysis-pending"
+        common_src = (
+            "from ninja import Schema\n\nclass FrameworkErrorSchema(Schema):\n"

+def run_limited(script: str, target: Path, extra: list[str], env_add: dict[str, str], limit: int):
+    script_path = NEW / script
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    env.update(env_add)
+    def limit_fds():
+        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, (limit, limit))
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(script_path), str(target), *extra],
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, preexec_fn=limit_fds,
+    )
+    return {"code": proc.returncode, "stdout": proc.stdout, "stderr": proc.stderr, "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start}

+def performance_probe():
+    count = 8000
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-perf.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        target = td / "fixture"
+        controller = target / "application/orders/driving_layer/api/order/order_controller.py"
+        controller.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        (target / "application/orders/application_layer/order").mkdir(parents=True)
+        chunks = []
+        for i in range(count):
+            chunks.append(
+                f"def operation_{i}():\n"
+                "    try:\n        pass\n"
+                "    except Exception:\n        pass\n\n"
+            )
+        controller.write_text("".join(chunks), encoding="utf-8")
+        extra = ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+        measurements: dict[str, list[float]] = {"old-unset": [], "new-unset": [], "new-devnull": [], "new-file": []}
+        codes = {}
+        for round_no in range(4):
+            rec = td / f"records-{round_no}.jsonl"
+            variants = [
+                ("old-unset", lambda: run("old", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra)),
+                ("new-unset", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra)),
+                ("new-devnull", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": "/dev/null"})),
+                ("new-file", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(rec)})),
+            ]
+            # Rotate start position to reduce fixed ordering bias.
+            variants = variants[round_no:] + variants[:round_no]
+            for label, thunk in variants:
+                result = thunk()
+                measurements[label].append(result["elapsed"])
+                codes[label] = result["code"]
+        medians = {label: sorted(values)[len(values)//2] for label, values in measurements.items()}
+        limited_rec = td / "limited.jsonl"
+        limited = run_limited(
+            "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra,
+            {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(limited_rec)}, 16,
+        )
+        last_rec = td / "records-3.jsonl"
+        # round rotation means records-3 may or may not be last, but is written exactly once.
+        summary = {
+            "summary": "performance",
+            "findings": count,
+            "source_bytes": controller.stat().st_size,
+            "samples": {k: [round(x, 4) for x in v] for k, v in measurements.items()},
+            "medians": {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in medians.items()},
+            "file_vs_unset_ratio": round(medians["new-file"] / medians["new-unset"], 3),
+            "new_unset_vs_old_ratio": round(medians["new-unset"] / medians["old-unset"], 3),
+            "codes": codes,
+            "record_lines": len(last_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()),
+            "record_bytes": last_rec.stat().st_size,
+            "fd_limit_16": {"code": limited["code"], "stderr_n": len(limited["stderr"]), "record_lines": len(limited_rec.read_bytes().splitlines())},
+        }
+        print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False))
+

def _tree_adopted(bcs: list[Path]) -> bool:
    for bc in bcs:
        if any((bc / n).is_dir() for n in _TREE_LAYERS):
            return True
        if any((bc / m).is_file() for m in _TREE_APP_MARKERS):
            return True
        if any(p.is_dir() and p.name.startswith("django_") for p in bc.iterdir()):
            return True
    return False


def _tree_camel(bc_name: str) -> str:
    return "".join(part.capitalize() for part in bc_name.split("_"))


def _tree_slice(root: Path, bcs: list[Path]) -> list[str]:
    # 라인 문면은 호출자(이 함수) 소유 그대로 — 레코드만 실규칙 rule 로 함께 나간다.
    findings: SliceFindings = SliceFindings()
    for bc in bcs:
        expected_prefix = _tree_camel(bc.name)
        schema_files: list[Path] = []
        for driving in _TREE_DRIVING:
            api = bc / driving / "api"
            if not api.is_dir():
                continue
            api_rel = api.relative_to(root)
            schema_file = api / "bc_error_schema.py"
            if schema_file.is_file():
                schema_files.append(schema_file)
            else:
                findings.add(
                    rule="#114",
                    line=f"  [#114] {api_rel}: `bc_error_schema.py` 가 없다 — HTTP 오류를 아직 안 여는 BC 에도 «빈 파일»로 항상 있다(부모 api/ 가 항상이라)",
                    where=api_rel,
                    msg="`bc_error_schema.py` 가 없다 — HTTP 오류를 아직 안 여는 BC 에도 «빈 파일»로 항상 있다(부모 api/ 가 항상이라)",
                )
            for p in sorted(api.glob("*.py")):
                low = p.name.lower()
                if p.name != "bc_error_schema.py" and "error" in low and "schema" in low:
                    findings.add(
                        rule="#568",
                        line=f"  [#568] {p.relative_to(root)}: 폴더 밖 이름은 «접미» 자다 — BC 오류 스키마 파일은 `bc_error_schema.py` 하나다",
                        where=p.relative_to(root),
                        msg="폴더 밖 이름은 «접미» 자다 — BC 오류 스키마 파일은 `bc_error_schema.py` 하나다",
                    )
            for schema_dir in api.rglob("schema"):
                if not schema_dir.is_dir():
                    continue
                for p in sorted(schema_dir.glob("*error*.py")):
                    findings.add(
                        rule="#568",
                        line=f"  [#568] {p.relative_to(root)}: `schema/` 안 이름은 «접두» 자(schema_in/schema_out)다 — 오류 스키마는 `api/bc_error_schema.py` 로",
                        where=p.relative_to(root),
                        msg="`schema/` 안 이름은 «접두» 자(schema_in/schema_out)다 — 오류 스키마는 `api/bc_error_schema.py` 로",
                    )
        if len(schema_files) > 1:
            findings.add(
                rule="#114",
                line=f"  [#114] {bc.relative_to(root)}: `bc_error_schema.py` 가 {len(schema_files)}개다 — BC 당 정확히 하나다",
                where=bc.relative_to(root),
                msg=f"`bc_error_schema.py` 가 {len(schema_files)}개다 — BC 당 정확히 하나다",
            )
        for schema_file in schema_files:
            rel = schema_file.relative_to(root)
            try:
                mod = ast.parse(schema_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            except (SyntaxError, OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
                # "#N" 꼴 밖 표지 — findings.py 가 rule=null + sentinel 로 격리한다(parse-fail 류).
                findings.add(
                    rule="분석",
                    line=f"  [분석] {rel}: bc_error_schema.py 를 파싱하지 못했다",
                    where=rel,
                    msg="bc_error_schema.py 를 파싱하지 못했다",
                )
                continue
            classes = [n for n in mod.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef)]
            schemas = [c for c in classes if c.name.endswith("ErrorSchema")]
            codes = [c for c in classes if c.name.endswith("ErrorCode")]
            strenum_names = {"StrEnum"}  # `from enum import StrEnum as X` 별칭도 StrEnum 이다
            for n in mod.body:
                if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom) and n.module == "enum":
                    strenum_names.update(a.asname or a.name for a in n.names if a.name == "StrEnum")
            if not schemas and not codes:
                continue  # 빈 파일 — HTTP 오류를 안 여는 BC(#114 문면)
            expected_schema = f"{expected_prefix}ErrorSchema"
            expected_code = f"{expected_prefix}ErrorCode"
            if not any(c.name == expected_schema for c in schemas):
                findings.add(
                    rule="#572",
                    line=f"  [#572] {rel}: 응답 본문 클래스 `{expected_schema}` 가 없다 — `<Bc>ErrorCode` 와 함께 온다(코드는 스키마 code 필드의 «타입»)",
                    where=rel,
                    msg=f"응답 본문 클래스 `{expected_schema}` 가 없다 — `<Bc>ErrorCode` 와 함께 온다(코드는 스키마 code 필드의 «타입»)",
                )
            if not any(c.name == expected_code for c in codes):
                findings.add(
                    rule="#572",
                    line=f"  [#572] {rel}: 오류 코드 `{expected_code}` 가 없다 — `<Bc>ErrorSchema` 와 함께 온다(떼면 둘이 따로 는다)",
                    where=rel,
                    msg=f"오류 코드 `{expected_code}` 가 없다 — `<Bc>ErrorSchema` 와 함께 온다(떼면 둘이 따로 는다)",
                )
            for code_cls in codes:
                base_names = {b.attr if isinstance(b, ast.Attribute) else getattr(b, "id", "") for b in code_cls.bases}
                if not (base_names & strenum_names):
                    findings.add(
                        rule="#636",
                        line=f"  [#636] {rel}: `{code_cls.name}` 는 `StrEnum` 이어야 한다 — Literal·맨 문자열 상수 모음으로 대신하지 않는다",
                        where=rel,
                        msg=f"`{code_cls.name}` 는 `StrEnum` 이어야 한다 — Literal·맨 문자열 상수 모음으로 대신하지 않는다",
                    )
    return findings

    return changed.returncode == 1


def _git_tree_has_tracked_changes(git_root: Path, directory: Path) -> bool:
    """HEAD 대비 디렉터리 변경 — 현재 inventory에서 사라진 staged deletion도 포함."""
    try:
        git_relative = directory.relative_to(git_root)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise UsageError(f"touched directory가 Git root 밖임: {directory}") from exc
    try:
        head = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", str(git_root), "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD"],
            capture_output=True,
            check=False,
        )
        if head.returncode != 0:
            return True
        changed = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", str(git_root), "diff", "--quiet", "HEAD", "--", git_relative.as_posix()],
            capture_output=True,
            check=False,
        )
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
        raise UsageError(f"touched directory 비교 불능: {git_relative} ({exc})") from exc
    if changed.returncode not in {0, 1}:
        detail = os.fsdecode(changed.stderr).strip() or os.fsdecode(changed.stdout).strip()
        raise UsageError(f"touched directory 비교 불능: {git_relative} ({detail})")
    return changed.returncode == 1


def _path_is_under(path: Path, directory: Path) -> bool:
    try:
        path.relative_to(directory)
    except ValueError:
        return False
    return True


def _filtered_di_findings(root: Path, inventory: CodeInventory) -> ContractFindings:
    eligible = set(inventory.relative_paths)
    # 라인 문면은 이 함수 소유 그대로 — 반환 집합이 곧 출력 집합이라 레코드가 그 거울이다.
    findings: ContractFindings = ContractFindings(CONTRACT_REF)
    for bc in _find_bc_dirs(root):
        if not _has_any_layer(bc):
            continue
        bc_relative = bc.relative_to(root)
        bc_paths = sorted(
            (path for path in eligible if _path_is_under(path, bc_relative)),
            key=Path.as_posix,
        )
        if inventory.git_root is not None:
            current_path_touched = any(
                _git_path_is_touched(inventory.git_root, root / path) for path in bc_paths
            )
            tracked_tree_changed = _git_tree_has_tracked_changes(
                inventory.git_root, root / bc_relative
            )
            if not current_path_touched and not tracked_tree_changed:
                continue

        issues: list[str] = []
        composition_relative = bc_relative / COMPOSITION_DIR
        payload = sorted(
            path.name
            for path in bc_paths
            if _path_is_under(path, composition_relative)
            and path.name != "__init__.py"
            and (root / path).is_file()
        )
        if payload:
            issues.append(
                f"{COMPOSITION_DIR}/ 폴더에 배선 코드({', '.join(payload[:3])}) — DI 조립은 "
                "BC 루트 «폴더» `composition_root/`(결선은 `dependency_wiring.py` — 트리 2~4행)가 소유한다"
            )

        for path in bc_paths:
            if path.name != COMPOSITION_FILE or not (root / path).is_file():
                continue
            local = path.relative_to(bc_relative)
            if _path_is_under(path, composition_relative):
                continue
            issues.append(
                f"{local.as_posix()} — 단일 파일 `{COMPOSITION_FILE}` 모양은 트리에 없다 — "
                "정본은 BC 루트 «폴더» `composition_root/`(트리 2행)다"
            )

        application_relative = bc_relative / "application_layer"
        needs_root = any(
            _path_is_under(path, application_relative)
            and path.name != "__init__.py"
            and "dto" not in path.relative_to(application_relative).parts
            and (root / path).is_file()
            for path in bc_paths
        )
        if needs_root and not (root / bc_relative / "composition_root").is_dir():
            issues.insert(
                0,
                "`composition_root/` 부재 — application 로직(command/query/service 등)을 가진 BC는 "
                "DI 조립을 BC 루트 폴더 `composition_root/`(결선은 `dependency_wiring.py` — 트리 2~4행)가 "
                "소유한다(배선을 `di/`·`wiring/`·라우터·config 에 두지 않는다)",
            )
        for issue in issues:
            findings.add(f"  - {bc_relative}: {issue}", where=bc_relative, msg=issue)
    return findings


def _module_name(relative_path: Path) -> str:
    return ".".join(relative_path.with_suffix("").parts)


def _expression_dotted_name(node: ast.AST) -> str | None:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        owner = _expression_dotted_name(node.value)
        if owner is not None:
            return f"{owner}.{node.attr}"
    return None


def _target_names(target: ast.AST) -> set[str]:
    if isinstance(target, ast.Name):
        return {target.id}
    if isinstance(target, ast.Starred):
        return _target_names(target.value)
    if isinstance(target, (ast.Tuple, ast.List)):
        return {name for item in target.elts for name in _target_names(item)}
    return set()


def _direct_statement_bound_names(
    node: ast.stmt, *, annotations_evaluated: bool
) -> set[str]:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
        for n in ast.walk(mod) if isinstance(n, ast.Call)
    }
    for name, lineno in imported_regs.items():
        if name not in called:
            call_where: str = f"{rel}:{lineno}"
            call_msg: str = f"`{name}` 을 import 하고 부르지 않았다 — urls.py 는 각 BC 의 `register_<bc>_api(api)` 를 «명시적으로 부른다»"
            findings.add("#440", line=f"  [#440] {call_where} {call_msg}", where=call_where, msg=call_msg)


def _standard_tree_slice(root: Path) -> tuple[SliceFindings, SliceFindings]:
    # 라인 문면은 각 _check_* 소유 그대로 — 레코드만 실규칙("#N")으로 얹는다(ⓓ 후보는 info).
    findings: SliceFindings = SliceFindings()
    candidates: SliceFindings = SliceFindings()
    for bc in _find_bc_dirs(root):
        if not _has_any_layer(bc):
            continue
        bc_rel = bc.relative_to(root)
        _check_composition_dir(bc, bc_rel, findings, candidates)
        _check_inner_driving_imports(bc, bc_rel, findings)
        _check_api_dir(bc, bc_rel, findings, candidates)
    for d in _find_project_dirs(root):
        api_py = d / "api.py"
        if api_py.is_file():
            _check_project_api(api_py, api_py.relative_to(root), findings)
        urls_py = d / "urls.py"
        if urls_py.is_file():
            _check_project_urls(urls_py, urls_py.relative_to(root), findings)
    return findings, candidates


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    try:
        config = _parse_config(argv[1:])
        if config.anchor is not None:
            # 재료 선검증 — 무발견 clean 이라도 resolve 불능 앵커·부재/형식 오류 빚
            # 파일·공허 차분이 침묵 exit 0 되지 않게 parse 직후 막는다(fail-closed).
            anchor_diff.validate_materials(config.root, config.anchor, config.anchor_debt_file)
        inventory = _code_inventory(config.root)
        parsed: dict[Path, ParsedSource] = {}
        if config.profile in {"dddjango-code-json", "preserve-established"}:
            parsed = _selected_sources(config, inventory)
        composition_findings: list[Finding] = []
        if config.profile == "dddjango-code-json":
            analysis, composition_findings = _composition_semantics(config, parsed)
            if analysis:
                raise UsageError("; ".join(analysis))
        di_findings = _filtered_di_findings(config.root, inventory)
        tree_findings, tree_candidates = _standard_tree_slice(config.root)
    except (UsageError, anchor_diff.AnchorDiffUsage) as exc:
        print(f"[check-composition-root] 사용 오류: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except SystemExit as exc:  # argparse --help
        return int(exc.code)

    if composition_findings:
        print("[check-composition-root] BLOCKER — API registrar/URLconf 조립 계약 위반:")
        # 레코드는 출력 대상과 1:1 거울 — 라인 문면은 render() 소유 그대로(선행 계약 판형).
        code_records = ContractFindings(CONTRACT_REF)
        for finding in composition_findings:
            code_records.add(
                finding.render(),
                where=f"{finding.relative_path}:{finding.lineno}",
                msg=f"{finding.category} — {finding.shown}",
                symbol=finding.category,
            )
        for line in code_records:
            print(line)
        print(
            "  API 근거: implementation-django-ninja §2.2·discipline-houserules final.md §1. "
            "각 BC의 canonical `driving_layer/api/api_router.py`가 "
            "`register_<bc>_api(api)` 안에서만 controller를 등록하고, 선택 URLconf가 "
            "선택 API object를 각 registrar에 정확히 한 번 전달한다. 위 finding의 "
            "signature/provenance/owner/count를 그 직접 계약에 맞춰라."
        )
    if di_findings:
        print(
            "[check-composition-root] BLOCKER — DI 조립(컴포지션 루트)이 정본 폴더 "
            "`composition_root/` 밖에 있거나 부재다(off-tree `composition/` 폴더·단일 파일 모양·부재):"
        )
        for finding in di_findings:
            print(finding)
        print(
            "  근거: discipline-houserules final.md §1(트리 2~4행). DI 조립은 BC 루트 «폴더» "
            "`application/<bc>/composition_root/`가 소유하고(결선은 `dependency_wiring.py` · "
            "사실 결선은 `event_wiring.py`), driving 쪽은 `build_<use_case>()` 팩토리를 "
            "매요청 호출만 한다 — feature별 `composition/` 폴더로 쪼개거나 계층 하위에 묻거나 "
            "단일 파일 `composition_root.py` 모양으로 두지 않는다(operation 본문에서 "
            "`Django…Repository()`/`…Adapter()`를 직접 생성하지 않는 Q-7의 짝). `composition/` "
            "폴더의 provider들과 단일 파일의 배선은 `composition_root/dependency_wiring.py`로 "
            "옮겨라. application 로직(command/query/service 등)을 가졌는데 정본이 아예 없으면(부재) "
            "BC 루트에 `composition_root/` 폴더를 만들어 배선을 둬라(데이터소스 BC는 해당 없음)."
        )
    if tree_findings:
        print("[check-composition-root] BLOCKER — 표준 트리 결선·등록 규율 위반 (트리 2~4·8·9·136·137행):")
        for f in tree_findings:
            print(f)
    if tree_candidates:
        print("[check-composition-root] ⓓ 후보 — 기계가 후보를 좁혔다 · 마무리 물음은 discipline-reviewer 몫(exit 불산입):")
        for c in tree_candidates:
            print(c)
    if composition_findings or di_findings or tree_findings:
        if config.anchor is not None:
            all_findings: list[str] = [
                *(finding.render() for finding in composition_findings),
                *di_findings,
                *tree_findings,
            ]
            try:
                return anchor_diff.partition_exit(
                    script=Path(__file__).resolve(),
                    label="[check-composition-root]",
                    target=config.root,
                    anchor=config.anchor,
                    argv=argv[1:],
                    findings=all_findings,
                    path_flags=frozenset(
                        {"--api-module", "--urlconf-module", "--registrar-module"}
                    ),
                    debt_file=config.anchor_debt_file,
                )
            except anchor_diff.AnchorDiffUsage as exc:
                print(f"[check-composition-root] 사용 오류: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
                return 1
        return 2

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CodeInventory:
    function: ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef,
) -> set[int]:
    for decorator in function.decorator_list:
        if not isinstance(decorator, ast.Call):
            continue
        for keyword in decorator.keywords:
            if keyword.arg != "response":
                continue
            if not isinstance(keyword.value, ast.Dict):
                return set()
            return {
                status
                for key in keyword.value.keys
                if key is not None
                for status in [_literal_status(key)]
                if status is not None
            }
    return set()


def _scan_openapi_extra_statuses(
    function: ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef,
) -> set[int]:
    statuses: set[int] = set()
    for decorator in function.decorator_list:
        if not isinstance(decorator, ast.Call):
            continue
        for keyword in decorator.keywords:
            if keyword.arg != "openapi_extra" or not isinstance(keyword.value, ast.Dict):
                continue
            for key, value in zip(keyword.value.keys, keyword.value.values):
                if (
                    isinstance(key, ast.Constant)
                    and key.value == "responses"
                    and isinstance(value, ast.Dict)
                ):
                    for status_key in value.keys:
                        status = (
                            _literal_status(status_key)
                            if status_key is not None
                            else None
                        )
                        if status is not None and 400 <= status <= 599:
                            statuses.add(status)
    return statuses


def _scan_operations(source: str) -> list[str]:
    if not NINJA_IMPORT_RE.search(source):
        return []
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(source)
    except SyntaxError:
        return []
    findings: list[str] = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if not isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            continue
        missing = sorted(
            _scan_openapi_extra_statuses(node) - _scan_response_statuses(node)
        )
        if missing:
            findings.append(
                f"operation '{node.name}' "
                f"(오류 {missing} 가 openapi_extra 에만·response= 누락)"
            )
    return findings


def _scan_is_new_or_modified(root: Path, file_path: Path) -> bool:
    if not (root / ".git").exists():
        return True
    try:
        relative = file_path.relative_to(root)
    except ValueError:
        return True
    try:
        tracked = subprocess.run(
            [
                "git",
                "-C",
                str(root),
                "ls-files",
                "--error-unmatch",
                str(relative),
            ],
            capture_output=True,
        )
        if tracked.returncode != 0:
            return True
        changed = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", str(root), "diff", "--quiet", "HEAD", "--", str(relative)]
        )
        return changed.returncode != 0
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        return True


def _repo_scan_findings(root: Path) -> list[str]:
    findings: list[str] = []
    for path in _scan_driving_files(root):
        try:
            source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except OSError:
            continue
        hits = _scan_operations(source)

+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+

+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+

+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])

+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))

+def compare_cases(cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]], summary: str) -> None:
+    diffs = 0
+    exits: dict[str, list[int]] = {}

+def error_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-errors.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            source = FIX / lane / red_sub
+            for kind in ("syntax", "invalid_utf8", "unreadable_file", "unreadable_dir"):
+                target = copied(source, td, f"{kind}-{script}")
+                files = sorted(target.rglob("*.py"))
+                if not files:
+                    continue
+                chosen = files[0]
+                restore: Path | None = None
+                if kind == "syntax":
+                    chosen.write_text("def broken(:\n", encoding="utf-8")
+                elif kind == "invalid_utf8":
+                    chosen.write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\x00")
+                elif kind == "unreadable_file":
+                    chosen.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen
+                else:
+                    chosen.parent.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen.parent
+                try:
+                    old = run("old", script, target, profile)
+                    new = run("new", script, target, profile)
+                finally:
+                    if restore is not None:
+                        restore.chmod(0o755 if restore.is_dir() else 0o644)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "errors", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+

+def load_module(path: Path, name: str):
+    previous = list(sys.path)
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(path.parent))
+    try:
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+        assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        sys.modules[name] = module
+        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+        return module
+    finally:
+        sys.path[:] = previous
+
+
+def path_contract():
+    os.environ.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    old_mod = load_module(OLD / "check-db-table.py", "old_db_table_probe")
+    new_mod = load_module(NEW / "findings.py", "new_findings_probe")
+    from pathlib import PureWindowsPath
+    values = [
+        Path("application/orders/models.py"),
+        Path("../relative/with space.py"),
+        Path("/tmp/absolute/models.py"),
+        Path(r"application\\orders\\models.py"),
+        PureWindowsPath(r"C:\\repo\\application\\orders\\models.py"),
+        Path("application/orders/model.py:27"),
+    ]
+    rows = []
+    for value in values:
+        old_f = old_mod.Findings()
+        old_f.add("#1", value, "message")
+        new_f = new_mod.Findings("check-db-table.py")
+        new_f.add("#1", value, "message")
+        rows.append({"input": repr(value), "old": list(old_f), "new": list(new_f), "same": list(old_f) == list(new_f)})
+    # Actual checker calls through Path values, with absolute and relative TARGET spelling.
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-paths.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        target = copied(FIX / "db_table/bad_rules", td, "fixture with space")
+        actual = []
+        for label, target_arg, cwd in (
+            ("absolute-target", target, None),
+            ("relative-target", Path("fixture with space"), td),
+        ):
+            old = run("old", "check-db-table.py", target_arg, [], cwd=cwd)
+            new = run("new", "check-db-table.py", target_arg, [], cwd=cwd)
+            actual.append({"label": label, "same": same(old, new), "old": describe(old), "new": describe(new)})
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": "path-contract", "direct": rows, "actual": actual}, ensure_ascii=False))

+GIT_ID = ["-c", "user.email=r-lane@example.invalid", "-c", "user.name=R Lane"]

+
+def git(repo: Path, *args: str):
+    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *GIT_ID, *args], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+
+
+def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
+    for args in (("add", "-A"), ("commit", "-q", "-m", message)):
+        proc = git(repo, *args)
+        if proc.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.decode().strip()
+
+
+def init_repo(dest: Path, source: Path) -> tuple[Path, str]:
+    shutil.copytree(source, dest)
+    proc = git(dest, "init", "-q")
+    if proc.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return dest, commit_all(dest, "anchor")
+

+def anchor_matrix():
+    specs = [
+        ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+        ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+        ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+        ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+        ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ]
+    cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]] = []
+    anchor_record = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-anchor.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for script, auto, lane in specs:
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            # bogus resolve on a clean green repository.
+            green_repo, _ = init_repo(td / f"bogus-{script}", FIX / lane / "good")
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-bogus", script, green_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", "deadbeef"]))
+            # vacuous diff: HEAD and clean.
+            vac_repo, vac_head = init_repo(td / f"vacuous-{script}", FIX / lane / "bad_rules")
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-vacuous", script, vac_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", vac_head]))
+            # all findings already at anchor; harmless dirty file makes diff non-vacuous.
+            existing_repo, existing_head = init_repo(td / f"existing-{script}", FIX / lane / "bad_rules")
+            (existing_repo / "harmless.txt").write_text("dirty\n", encoding="utf-8")
+            existing_args = [*profile, "--anchor", existing_head]
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-existing", script, existing_repo, existing_args))
+            # red material copied after green anchor: new findings.
+            new_repo, new_head = init_repo(td / f"new-{script}", FIX / lane / "good")
+            shutil.copytree(FIX / lane / "bad_rules", new_repo, dirs_exist_ok=True)
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-new", script, new_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", new_head]))
+
+            # DJR channel is inherited by the baseline child. Compare output and count inflation.
+            plain_rec = td / f"plain-{script}.jsonl"
+            anchor_rec = td / f"anchor-{script}.jsonl"
+            plain = run("new", script, existing_repo, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(plain_rec)})
+            anchored = run("new", script, existing_repo, existing_args, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(anchor_rec)})
+            anchor_record[script] = {
+                "output_same_as_unset": same(run("new", script, existing_repo, existing_args), anchored),
+                "plain_count": len(plain_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()) if plain_rec.exists() else 0,
+                "anchor_count": len(anchor_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()) if anchor_rec.exists() else 0,
+                "plain_exit": plain["code"],
+                "anchor_exit": anchored["code"],
+            }
+
+        # analysis_pending=True: an anchor-existing tree finding plus dynamic error shape proof.
+        analysis_repo = td / "analysis-pending"
+        common_src = (
+            "from ninja import Schema\n\nclass FrameworkErrorSchema(Schema):\n"
+            "    code: str\n    title: str\n    status: int\n    detail: str\n"
+        )
+        dynamic_src = (
+            "from enum import StrEnum\n"
+            "from framework.ninja.framework_error_schema import FrameworkErrorSchema\n\n"
+            "_BASE = 'lesson'\n"
+            "class LessonErrorCode(StrEnum):\n"
+            "    _ignore_ = ['_BASE']\n"
+            "    _BASE = _BASE\n"
+            "    NOT_FOUND = f'{_BASE}_not_found'\n\n"
+            "class LessonErrorSchema(FrameworkErrorSchema):\n    code: LessonErrorCode\n"
+        )
+        write_tree(analysis_repo, {
+            "framework/ninja/framework_error_schema.py": common_src,
+            "application/lesson/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py": dynamic_src,
+            "application/lesson/driving_layer/controller.py": "def get_lesson(request): return {'id': 1}\n",
+            "application/report/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py": "",
+            "config/api.py": "from ninja_extra import NinjaExtraAPI\napi = NinjaExtraAPI()\n",
+        })

+        if proc.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+        analysis_head = commit_all(analysis_repo, "dynamic anchor")
+        (analysis_repo / "harmless.txt").write_text("dirty\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        analysis_args = [
+            "--error-profile", "dddjango-code-json", "--scope", "public-v1",

+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "anchor-record-inheritance", "rows": anchor_record}, ensure_ascii=False))

+def run_limited(script: str, target: Path, extra: list[str], env_add: dict[str, str], limit: int):
+    script_path = NEW / script
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    env.update(env_add)
+    def limit_fds():
+        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, (limit, limit))
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(script_path), str(target), *extra],
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, preexec_fn=limit_fds,
+    )
+    return {"code": proc.returncode, "stdout": proc.stdout, "stderr": proc.stderr, "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start}
+
+
+def performance_probe():
+    count = 8000
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-perf.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        target = td / "fixture"
+        controller = target / "application/orders/driving_layer/api/order/order_controller.py"
+        controller.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        (target / "application/orders/application_layer/order").mkdir(parents=True)
+        chunks = []
+        for i in range(count):
+            chunks.append(
+                f"def operation_{i}():\n"
+                "    try:\n        pass\n"
+                "    except Exception:\n        pass\n\n"
+            )
+        controller.write_text("".join(chunks), encoding="utf-8")
+        extra = ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+        measurements: dict[str, list[float]] = {"old-unset": [], "new-unset": [], "new-devnull": [], "new-file": []}
+        codes = {}
+        for round_no in range(4):
+            rec = td / f"records-{round_no}.jsonl"
+            variants = [
+                ("old-unset", lambda: run("old", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra)),
+                ("new-unset", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra)),
+                ("new-devnull", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": "/dev/null"})),
+                ("new-file", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(rec)})),
+            ]
+            # Rotate start position to reduce fixed ordering bias.
+            variants = variants[round_no:] + variants[:round_no]
+            for label, thunk in variants:
+                result = thunk()
+                measurements[label].append(result["elapsed"])
+                codes[label] = result["code"]
+        medians = {label: sorted(values)[len(values)//2] for label, values in measurements.items()}
+        limited_rec = td / "limited.jsonl"
+        limited = run_limited(
+            "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra,
+            {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(limited_rec)}, 16,
+        )
+        last_rec = td / "records-3.jsonl"
+        # round rotation means records-3 may or may not be last, but is written exactly once.
+        summary = {
+            "summary": "performance",
+            "findings": count,
+            "source_bytes": controller.stat().st_size,
+            "samples": {k: [round(x, 4) for x in v] for k, v in measurements.items()},
+            "medians": {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in medians.items()},
+            "file_vs_unset_ratio": round(medians["new-file"] / medians["new-unset"], 3),
+            "new_unset_vs_old_ratio": round(medians["new-unset"] / medians["old-unset"], 3),
+            "codes": codes,
+            "record_lines": len(last_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()),
+            "record_bytes": last_rec.stat().st_size,
+            "fd_limit_16": {"code": limited["code"], "stderr_n": len(limited["stderr"]), "record_lines": len(limited_rec.read_bytes().splitlines())},
+        }
+        print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["baseline", "record", "profiles", "errors", "paths", "anchor", "performance"])
+    ns = parser.parse_args()
+    if ns.mode == "baseline":
+        baseline_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "record":
+        record_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "profiles":
+        profile_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "errors":
+        error_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "paths":
+        path_contract()
+    elif ns.mode == "anchor":
+        anchor_matrix()
+    else:
+        performance_probe()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Executable RED matrix for the planned dddjango API-error checkers.

The matrix intentionally uses only source text and checker subprocesses.  It is
an executable specification for the future ``dddjango-code-json`` checker CLI;
it must not import Django or Ninja itself.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Final


REPOSITORY_ROOT: Final = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CHECKER_DIR: Final = REPOSITORY_ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
TARGET_DIR: Final = "TARGET_DIR"
AUTO_PROFILE_ARGS: Final = (TARGET_DIR, "--error-profile", "auto")
MATCH_SYNTAX_SUPPORTED: Final = sys.version_info >= (3, 10)

# This is deliberately the full public vocabulary of the future Coordinator
# command.  Keeping it here makes a changed prompt/checker CLI observable in
# one executable place instead of leaving a prose-only contract behind.
ARGUMENT_ARITY: Final = {
    "--error-profile": 1,
    "--scope": 1,
    "--api-module": 1,
    "--controller-module": 1,
    "--urlconf-module": 1,
    "--registrar-module": 1,
    "--scope-bc": 1,
    "--error-bc": 1,
    "--project-code-error-module": 1,
    "--project-preserve-error-module": 1,
}

        "--urlconf-module",

        "--project-preserve-error-module",
    }
)
SINGULAR_ARGUMENTS: Final = frozenset(
    {"--error-profile", "--scope", "--api-module", "--urlconf-module"}
)
CHECKER_ALLOWED_ARGUMENTS: Final = {
    "check-error-centralization.py": frozenset(
        {
            "--error-profile",

+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def copied(src: Path, parent: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest
+
+

+        file_target.write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        nonexistent = td / "does-not-exist"
+        empty = td / "empty"
+        empty.mkdir()
+
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            green_sub = "good_bc" if lane == "skeleton" else "good"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            green = copied(FIX / lane / green_sub, td, f"green-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            cases = [
+                ("red", red, profile, None),
+                ("green", green, profile, None),
+                ("noargs", None, [], empty),
+                ("nonexistent", nonexistent, profile, None),
+                ("file_target", file_target, profile, None),
+                ("bc_shaped", bc_target, profile, None),
+                ("unknown_option", green, [*profile, "--not-a-real-option"], None),
+                ("help", green, ["--help"], None),
+            ]
+            for kind, target, extra, cwd in cases:
+                old = run("old", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                new = run("new", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "baseline", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))

+def record_matrix():
+    valid_changed = []
+    invalid_changed = []
+    old_env_changed = []
+    valid_record_counts = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-record.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        invalid_path = td / "missing-parent" / "records.jsonl"
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            unset_new = run("new", script, red, profile)
+            valid_path = td / f"{script}.jsonl"
+            set_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(valid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, set_new):
+                valid_changed.append(script)
+                emit_diff(f"record-valid:{script}", unset_new, set_new)
+            valid_record_counts[script] = len(valid_path.read_bytes().splitlines()) if valid_path.exists() else 0
+            bad_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_new, bad_new):
+                invalid_changed.append(script)
+            unset_old = run("old", script, red, profile)
+            set_old = run("old", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+            if not same(unset_old, set_old):
+                old_env_changed.append(script)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "record",
+            "valid_stdout_stderr_exit_changed": valid_changed,
+            "invalid_path_changed_count": len(invalid_changed),
+            "invalid_path_changed": invalid_changed,
+            "old_env_changed": old_env_changed,
+            "valid_record_counts": valid_record_counts,
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+        script = "check-db-table.py"
+        red = td / f"red-{script}"
+        unset_old = run("old", script, red, [])
+        unset_new = run("new", script, red, [])
+        bad_new = run("new", script, red, [], {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+        emit_diff("representative-old-vs-new-unset", unset_old, unset_new)
+        emit_diff("representative-new-unset-vs-invalid-record", unset_new, bad_new)
+

+def write_tree(root: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+    for rel, source in files.items():
+        path = root / rel
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def compare_cases(cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]], summary: str) -> None:
+    diffs = 0
+    exits: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
+    for label, script, target, extra in cases:
+        old = run("old", script, target, extra)
+        new = run("new", script, target, extra)
+        exits[label] = [old["code"], new["code"]]
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff(label, old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": summary, "comparisons": len(cases), "diffs": diffs, "exits": exits}, ensure_ascii=False))
+

+def error_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-errors.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            source = FIX / lane / red_sub
+            for kind in ("syntax", "invalid_utf8", "unreadable_file", "unreadable_dir"):
+                target = copied(source, td, f"{kind}-{script}")
+                files = sorted(target.rglob("*.py"))
+                if not files:
+                    continue
+                chosen = files[0]
+                restore: Path | None = None
+                if kind == "syntax":
+                    chosen.write_text("def broken(:\n", encoding="utf-8")
+                elif kind == "invalid_utf8":
+                    chosen.write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\x00")
+                elif kind == "unreadable_file":
+                    chosen.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen
+                else:
+                    chosen.parent.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen.parent
+                try:
+                    old = run("old", script, target, profile)
+                    new = run("new", script, target, profile)
+                finally:
+                    if restore is not None:
+                        restore.chmod(0o755 if restore.is_dir() else 0o644)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "errors", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def load_module(path: Path, name: str):
+    previous = list(sys.path)
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(path.parent))
+    try:
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+        assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        sys.modules[name] = module
+        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+        return module
+    finally:
+        sys.path[:] = previous
+
+

+    os.environ.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)

+        PureWindowsPath(r"C:\\repo\\application\\orders\\models.py"),
+        Path("application/orders/model.py:27"),
+    ]
+    rows = []
+    for value in values:
+        old_f = old_mod.Findings()
+        old_f.add("#1", value, "message")
+        new_f = new_mod.Findings("check-db-table.py")
+        new_f.add("#1", value, "message")
+        rows.append({"input": repr(value), "old": list(old_f), "new": list(new_f), "same": list(old_f) == list(new_f)})
+    # Actual checker calls through Path values, with absolute and relative TARGET spelling.
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-paths.") as td_s:

+            ("absolute-target", target, None),
+            ("relative-target", Path("fixture with space"), td),
+        ):
+            old = run("old", "check-db-table.py", target_arg, [], cwd=cwd)
+            new = run("new", "check-db-table.py", target_arg, [], cwd=cwd)
+            actual.append({"label": label, "same": same(old, new), "old": describe(old), "new": describe(new)})
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": "path-contract", "direct": rows, "actual": actual}, ensure_ascii=False))
