+def error_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-errors.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            source = FIX / lane / red_sub
+            for kind in ("syntax", "invalid_utf8", "unreadable_file", "unreadable_dir"):
+                target = copied(source, td, f"{kind}-{script}")
+                files = sorted(target.rglob("*.py"))
+                if not files:
+                    continue
+                chosen = files[0]
+                restore: Path | None = None
+                if kind == "syntax":
+                    chosen.write_text("def broken(:\n", encoding="utf-8")
+                elif kind == "invalid_utf8":
+                    chosen.write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\x00")
+                elif kind == "unreadable_file":
+                    chosen.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen
+                else:
+                    chosen.parent.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen.parent
+                try:
+                    old = run("old", script, target, profile)
+                    new = run("new", script, target, profile)
+                finally:
+                    if restore is not None:
+                        restore.chmod(0o755 if restore.is_dir() else 0o644)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "errors", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))

+def load_module(path: Path, name: str):
+    previous = list(sys.path)
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(path.parent))
+    try:
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+        assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        sys.modules[name] = module
+        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+        return module
+    finally:
+        sys.path[:] = previous
+

+GIT_ID = ["-c", "user.email=r-lane@example.invalid", "-c", "user.name=R Lane"]
+
+
+def git(repo: Path, *args: str):
+    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *GIT_ID, *args], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+
+
+def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
+    for args in (("add", "-A"), ("commit", "-q", "-m", message)):
+        proc = git(repo, *args)
+        if proc.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.decode().strip()
+
+
+def init_repo(dest: Path, source: Path) -> tuple[Path, str]:
+    shutil.copytree(source, dest)
+    proc = git(dest, "init", "-q")
+    if proc.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return dest, commit_all(dest, "anchor")

+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            # bogus resolve on a clean green repository.
+            green_repo, _ = init_repo(td / f"bogus-{script}", FIX / lane / "good")
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-bogus", script, green_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", "deadbeef"]))
+            # vacuous diff: HEAD and clean.
+            vac_repo, vac_head = init_repo(td / f"vacuous-{script}", FIX / lane / "bad_rules")
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-vacuous", script, vac_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", vac_head]))
+            # all findings already at anchor; harmless dirty file makes diff non-vacuous.
+            existing_repo, existing_head = init_repo(td / f"existing-{script}", FIX / lane / "bad_rules")
+            (existing_repo / "harmless.txt").write_text("dirty\n", encoding="utf-8")
+            existing_args = [*profile, "--anchor", existing_head]
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-existing", script, existing_repo, existing_args))
+            # red material copied after green anchor: new findings.
+            new_repo, new_head = init_repo(td / f"new-{script}", FIX / lane / "good")
+            shutil.copytree(FIX / lane / "bad_rules", new_repo, dirs_exist_ok=True)
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-new", script, new_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", new_head]))
+
+            # DJR channel is inherited by the baseline child. Compare output and count inflation.
+            plain_rec = td / f"plain-{script}.jsonl"
+            anchor_rec = td / f"anchor-{script}.jsonl"
+            plain = run("new", script, existing_repo, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(plain_rec)})
+            anchored = run("new", script, existing_repo, existing_args, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(anchor_rec)})
+            anchor_record[script] = {
+                "output_same_as_unset": same(run("new", script, existing_repo, existing_args), anchored),
+                "plain_count": len(plain_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()) if plain_rec.exists() else 0,
+                "anchor_count": len(anchor_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()) if anchor_rec.exists() else 0,
+                "plain_exit": plain["code"],
+                "anchor_exit": anchored["code"],
+            }
+
+        # analysis_pending=True: an anchor-existing tree finding plus dynamic error shape proof.
+        analysis_repo = td / "analysis-pending"
+        common_src = (
+            "from ninja import Schema\n\nclass FrameworkErrorSchema(Schema):\n"
+            "    code: str\n    title: str\n    status: int\n    detail: str\n"
+        )
+        dynamic_src = (
+            "from enum import StrEnum\n"
+            "from framework.ninja.framework_error_schema import FrameworkErrorSchema\n\n"
+            "_BASE = 'lesson'\n"
+            "class LessonErrorCode(StrEnum):\n"

+            "application/report/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py": "",

+        })
+        proc = git(analysis_repo, "init", "-q")
+        if proc.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+        analysis_head = commit_all(analysis_repo, "dynamic anchor")
+        (analysis_repo / "harmless.txt").write_text("dirty\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        analysis_args = [
+            "--error-profile", "dddjango-code-json", "--scope", "public-v1",

+def run_limited(script: str, target: Path, extra: list[str], env_add: dict[str, str], limit: int):
+    script_path = NEW / script
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    env.update(env_add)
+    def limit_fds():
+        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, (limit, limit))
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(script_path), str(target), *extra],
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, preexec_fn=limit_fds,
+    )
+    return {"code": proc.returncode, "stdout": proc.stdout, "stderr": proc.stderr, "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start}
+
+
+def performance_probe():
+    count = 8000
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-perf.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        target = td / "fixture"
+        controller = target / "application/orders/driving_layer/api/order/order_controller.py"
+        controller.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        (target / "application/orders/application_layer/order").mkdir(parents=True)
+        chunks = []
+        for i in range(count):
+            chunks.append(
+                f"def operation_{i}():\n"
+                "    try:\n        pass\n"
+                "    except Exception:\n        pass\n\n"
+            )
+        controller.write_text("".join(chunks), encoding="utf-8")
+        extra = ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+        measurements: dict[str, list[float]] = {"old-unset": [], "new-unset": [], "new-devnull": [], "new-file": []}
+        codes = {}
+        for round_no in range(4):
+            rec = td / f"records-{round_no}.jsonl"
+            variants = [
+                ("old-unset", lambda: run("old", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra)),
+                ("new-unset", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra)),
+                ("new-devnull", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": "/dev/null"})),
+                ("new-file", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(rec)})),
+            ]
+            # Rotate start position to reduce fixed ordering bias.
+            variants = variants[round_no:] + variants[:round_no]
+            for label, thunk in variants:
+                result = thunk()
+                measurements[label].append(result["elapsed"])
+                codes[label] = result["code"]
+        medians = {label: sorted(values)[len(values)//2] for label, values in measurements.items()}
+        limited_rec = td / "limited.jsonl"
+        limited = run_limited(
+            "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra,
+            {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(limited_rec)}, 16,
+        )
+        last_rec = td / "records-3.jsonl"
+        # round rotation means records-3 may or may not be last, but is written exactly once.
+        summary = {
+            "summary": "performance",
+            "findings": count,
+            "source_bytes": controller.stat().st_size,
+            "samples": {k: [round(x, 4) for x in v] for k, v in measurements.items()},
+            "medians": {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in medians.items()},
+            "file_vs_unset_ratio": round(medians["new-file"] / medians["new-unset"], 3),
+            "new_unset_vs_old_ratio": round(medians["new-unset"] / medians["old-unset"], 3),
+            "codes": codes,
+            "record_lines": len(last_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()),
+            "record_bytes": last_rec.stat().st_size,
+            "fd_limit_16": {"code": limited["code"], "stderr_n": len(limited["stderr"]), "record_lines": len(limited_rec.read_bytes().splitlines())},
+        }
+        print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def hidden_branch_matrix():
+    matrix = load_module(ROOT / "workspace/tools/api_error_backstop_matrix.py", "api_error_matrix_probe")
+    all_cases = [
+        *matrix.schema_cases(),
+        *matrix.controller_cases(),
+        *matrix.composition_cases(),
+        *matrix.openapi_cases(),
+        *matrix.success_cases(),
+    ]
+    wanted = {
+        "schema-analysis-dynamic-enum-value",
+        "controller-analysis-alias-path-dynamic-payload",
+        "controller-dynamic-shape-marker-does-not-hide-custom-handler",
+        "controller-dynamic-shape-marker-does-not-hide-mutation",
+        "controller-dynamic-shape-runtime-proof-handoff",
+        "composition-v2-single-root-file-off-tree",
+        "composition-legacy-v1-off-tree-folder",
+        "composition-legacy-v3-required-root-absent",
+        "composition-code-v1-di-still-blocked",
+        "composition-code-v2-di-still-blocked",
+        "composition-code-v3-di-still-blocked",
+        "composition-registrar-rebinds-api-parameter",
+        "openapi-dynamic-shape-marker-does-not-hide-api-override",
+        "openapi-dynamic-shape-runtime-proof-handoff",
+        "openapi-custom-alias-generator-wrong-status",
+        "success-scope-clean-ambiguous-response-dynamic-kwargs",
+    }
+    selected = [case for case in all_cases if case.name in wanted]
+    missing = wanted - {case.name for case in selected}
+    if missing:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"missing backstop cases: {sorted(missing)}")
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    rows = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-hidden.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for index, case in enumerate(selected):
+            target = td / f"case-{index}"
+            target.mkdir()
+            if case.baseline_files is not None:
+                matrix.initialize_git_fixture(target, case.baseline_files)
+            matrix.write_fixture(target, case.files)
+            args = [str(target) if arg == matrix.TARGET_DIR else arg for arg in case.checker_args]
+            # run() supplies target separately, so strip the positional TARGET_DIR expansion.
+            if args and args[0] == str(target):
+                args = args[1:]
+            old = run("old", case.checker, target, args)
+            new = run("new", case.checker, target, args)
+            comparisons += 1
+            rows[case.name] = {"old": old["code"], "new": new["code"], "expected": case.expected_exit}
+            if not same(old, new):
+                diffs += 1
+                emit_diff(case.name, old, new)
+
+        # error-centralization tree-slice parse-fail sentinel line.
+        parse_target = td / "parse-fail"
+        write_tree(parse_target, {
+            "application/orders/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py": "def broken(:\n",
+        })
+        old = run("old", "check-error-centralization.py", parse_target, ["--error-profile", "auto"])
+        new = run("new", "check-error-centralization.py", parse_target, ["--error-profile", "auto"])
+        comparisons += 1
+        rows["error-centralization-tree-parse-fail"] = {
+            "old": old["code"], "new": new["code"],
+            "contains_analysis": b"[\xeb\xb6\x84\xec\x84\x9d]" in new["stdout"],
+        }
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff("error-centralization-tree-parse-fail", old, new)
+
+        # openapi repo_scan path without an application/<bc> tree, avoiding tree-slice interception.
+        repo_scan = td / "openapi-repo-scan"
+        write_tree(repo_scan, {
+            "src/orders/driving_layer/order_controller.py": (
+                "from ninja import Router\nrouter = Router()\n\n"
+                "@router.get('/', openapi_extra={'responses': {404: {'description': 'missing'}}})\n"
+                "def get_order(request):\n    return {'id': 1}\n"
+            )
+        })
+        old = run("old", "check-openapi-error-declaration.py", repo_scan, ["--error-profile", "auto"])
+        new = run("new", "check-openapi-error-declaration.py", repo_scan, ["--error-profile", "auto"])
+        comparisons += 1
+        rows["openapi-repo-scan"] = {
+            "old": old["code"], "new": new["code"], "repo_scan_header": b"openapi_extra" in new["stdout"]
+        }
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff("openapi-repo-scan", old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": "hidden", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "rows": rows}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["baseline", "record", "profiles", "errors", "paths", "anchor", "performance", "hidden"])
+    ns = parser.parse_args()
+    if ns.mode == "baseline":
+        baseline_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "record":
+        record_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "profiles":
+        profile_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "errors":
+        error_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "paths":
+        path_contract()
+    elif ns.mode == "anchor":
+        anchor_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "performance":
+        performance_probe()
+    else:
+        hidden_branch_matrix()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def copied(src: Path, parent: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest

+def write_tree(root: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+    for rel, source in files.items():
+        path = root / rel
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")

+def compare_cases(cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]], summary: str) -> None:
+    diffs = 0
+    exits: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
+    for label, script, target, extra in cases:
+        old = run("old", script, target, extra)
+        new = run("new", script, target, extra)
+        exits[label] = [old["code"], new["code"]]
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff(label, old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": summary, "comparisons": len(cases), "diffs": diffs, "exits": exits}, ensure_ascii=False))

+def error_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-errors.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            source = FIX / lane / red_sub
+            for kind in ("syntax", "invalid_utf8", "unreadable_file", "unreadable_dir"):
+                target = copied(source, td, f"{kind}-{script}")
+                files = sorted(target.rglob("*.py"))
+                if not files:
+                    continue
+                chosen = files[0]
+                restore: Path | None = None
+                if kind == "syntax":
+                    chosen.write_text("def broken(:\n", encoding="utf-8")
+                elif kind == "invalid_utf8":
+                    chosen.write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\x00")
+                elif kind == "unreadable_file":
+                    chosen.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen
+                else:
+                    chosen.parent.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen.parent
+                try:
+                    old = run("old", script, target, profile)
+                    new = run("new", script, target, profile)
+                finally:
+                    if restore is not None:
+                        restore.chmod(0o755 if restore.is_dir() else 0o644)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "errors", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+

+def load_module(path: Path, name: str):
+    previous = list(sys.path)
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(path.parent))
+    try:
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+        assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        sys.modules[name] = module
+        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+        return module
+    finally:
+        sys.path[:] = previous
+

+    os.environ.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    old_mod = load_module(OLD / "check-db-table.py", "old_db_table_probe")

+    ]
+    rows = []

+        old_f.add("#1", value, "message")
+        new_f = new_mod.Findings("check-db-table.py")
+        new_f.add("#1", value, "message")
+        rows.append({"input": repr(value), "old": list(old_f), "new": list(new_f), "same": list(old_f) == list(new_f)})
+    # Actual checker calls through Path values, with absolute and relative TARGET spelling.

+GIT_ID = ["-c", "user.email=r-lane@example.invalid", "-c", "user.name=R Lane"]
+
+
+def git(repo: Path, *args: str):
+    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *GIT_ID, *args], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+
+
+def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
+    for args in (("add", "-A"), ("commit", "-q", "-m", message)):
+        proc = git(repo, *args)
+        if proc.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.decode().strip()
+
+
+def init_repo(dest: Path, source: Path) -> tuple[Path, str]:
+    shutil.copytree(source, dest)
+    proc = git(dest, "init", "-q")
+    if proc.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return dest, commit_all(dest, "anchor")

+def anchor_matrix():
+    specs = [
+        ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),

+            # bogus resolve on a clean green repository.

+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-bogus", script, green_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", "deadbeef"]))
+            # vacuous diff: HEAD and clean.

+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-vacuous", script, vac_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", vac_head]))
+            # all findings already at anchor; harmless dirty file makes diff non-vacuous.
+            existing_repo, existing_head = init_repo(td / f"existing-{script}", FIX / lane / "bad_rules")
+            (existing_repo / "harmless.txt").write_text("dirty\n", encoding="utf-8")
+            existing_args = [*profile, "--anchor", existing_head]
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-existing", script, existing_repo, existing_args))
+            # red material copied after green anchor: new findings.
+            new_repo, new_head = init_repo(td / f"new-{script}", FIX / lane / "good")
+            shutil.copytree(FIX / lane / "bad_rules", new_repo, dirs_exist_ok=True)
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-new", script, new_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", new_head]))

+            # DJR channel is inherited by the baseline child. Compare output and count inflation.
+            plain_rec = td / f"plain-{script}.jsonl"
+            anchor_rec = td / f"anchor-{script}.jsonl"
+            plain = run("new", script, existing_repo, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(plain_rec)})
+            anchored = run("new", script, existing_repo, existing_args, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(anchor_rec)})
+            anchor_record[script] = {
+                "output_same_as_unset": same(run("new", script, existing_repo, existing_args), anchored),
+                "plain_count": len(plain_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()) if plain_rec.exists() else 0,
+                "anchor_count": len(anchor_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()) if anchor_rec.exists() else 0,
+                "plain_exit": plain["code"],
+                "anchor_exit": anchored["code"],
+            }

+        # analysis_pending=True: an anchor-existing tree finding plus dynamic error shape proof.
+        analysis_repo = td / "analysis-pending"
+        common_src = (

+            "    code: str\n    title: str\n    status: int\n    detail: str\n"

+def run_limited(script: str, target: Path, extra: list[str], env_add: dict[str, str], limit: int):
+    script_path = NEW / script
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    env.update(env_add)
+    def limit_fds():
+        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, (limit, limit))
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(script_path), str(target), *extra],
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, preexec_fn=limit_fds,
+    )
+    return {"code": proc.returncode, "stdout": proc.stdout, "stderr": proc.stderr, "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start}

+def performance_probe():
+    count = 8000
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-perf.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        target = td / "fixture"
+        controller = target / "application/orders/driving_layer/api/order/order_controller.py"
+        controller.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        (target / "application/orders/application_layer/order").mkdir(parents=True)
+        chunks = []
+        for i in range(count):
+            chunks.append(
+                f"def operation_{i}():\n"
+                "    try:\n        pass\n"
+                "    except Exception:\n        pass\n\n"
+            )
+        controller.write_text("".join(chunks), encoding="utf-8")
+        extra = ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+        measurements: dict[str, list[float]] = {"old-unset": [], "new-unset": [], "new-devnull": [], "new-file": []}
+        codes = {}
+        for round_no in range(4):
+            rec = td / f"records-{round_no}.jsonl"
+            variants = [
+                ("old-unset", lambda: run("old", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra)),
+                ("new-unset", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra)),
+                ("new-devnull", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": "/dev/null"})),
+                ("new-file", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(rec)})),
+            ]
+            # Rotate start position to reduce fixed ordering bias.
+            variants = variants[round_no:] + variants[:round_no]
+            for label, thunk in variants:
+                result = thunk()
+                measurements[label].append(result["elapsed"])
+                codes[label] = result["code"]
+        medians = {label: sorted(values)[len(values)//2] for label, values in measurements.items()}
+        limited_rec = td / "limited.jsonl"
+        limited = run_limited(
+            "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra,
+            {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(limited_rec)}, 16,
+        )
+        last_rec = td / "records-3.jsonl"
+        # round rotation means records-3 may or may not be last, but is written exactly once.
+        summary = {
+            "summary": "performance",
+            "findings": count,
+            "source_bytes": controller.stat().st_size,
+            "samples": {k: [round(x, 4) for x in v] for k, v in measurements.items()},
+            "medians": {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in medians.items()},
+            "file_vs_unset_ratio": round(medians["new-file"] / medians["new-unset"], 3),
+            "new_unset_vs_old_ratio": round(medians["new-unset"] / medians["old-unset"], 3),
+            "codes": codes,
+            "record_lines": len(last_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()),
+            "record_bytes": last_rec.stat().st_size,
+            "fd_limit_16": {"code": limited["code"], "stderr_n": len(limited["stderr"]), "record_lines": len(limited_rec.read_bytes().splitlines())},
+        }
+        print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False))
+

+def hidden_branch_matrix():
+    matrix = load_module(ROOT / "workspace/tools/api_error_backstop_matrix.py", "api_error_matrix_probe")
+    all_cases = [
+        *matrix.schema_cases(),
+        *matrix.controller_cases(),
+        *matrix.composition_cases(),
+        *matrix.openapi_cases(),
+        *matrix.success_cases(),
+    ]
+    wanted = {
+        "schema-analysis-dynamic-enum-value",
+        "controller-analysis-alias-path-dynamic-payload",
+        "controller-dynamic-shape-marker-does-not-hide-custom-handler",
+        "controller-dynamic-shape-marker-does-not-hide-mutation",
+        "controller-dynamic-shape-runtime-proof-handoff",
+        "composition-v2-single-root-file-off-tree",
+        "composition-legacy-v1-off-tree-folder",
+        "composition-legacy-v3-required-root-absent",
+        "composition-code-v1-di-still-blocked",
+        "composition-code-v2-di-still-blocked",
+        "composition-code-v3-di-still-blocked",
+        "composition-registrar-rebinds-api-parameter",
+        "openapi-dynamic-shape-marker-does-not-hide-api-override",
+        "openapi-dynamic-shape-runtime-proof-handoff",
+        "openapi-custom-alias-generator-wrong-status",
+        "success-scope-clean-ambiguous-response-dynamic-kwargs",
+    }
+    selected = [case for case in all_cases if case.name in wanted]
+    missing = wanted - {case.name for case in selected}
+    if missing:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"missing backstop cases: {sorted(missing)}")
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    rows = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-hidden.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for index, case in enumerate(selected):
+            target = td / f"case-{index}"
+            target.mkdir()
+            if case.baseline_files is not None:
+                matrix.initialize_git_fixture(target, case.baseline_files)
+            matrix.write_fixture(target, case.files)
+            args = [str(target) if arg == matrix.TARGET_DIR else arg for arg in case.checker_args]
+            # run() supplies target separately, so strip the positional TARGET_DIR expansion.
+            if args and args[0] == str(target):
+                args = args[1:]
+            old = run("old", case.checker, target, args)
+            new = run("new", case.checker, target, args)
+            comparisons += 1
+            rows[case.name] = {"old": old["code"], "new": new["code"], "expected": case.expected_exit}
+            if not same(old, new):
+                diffs += 1
+                emit_diff(case.name, old, new)
+
+        # error-centralization tree-slice parse-fail sentinel line.
+        parse_target = td / "parse-fail"
+        write_tree(parse_target, {
+            "application/orders/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py": "def broken(:\n",
+        })
+        old = run("old", "check-error-centralization.py", parse_target, ["--error-profile", "auto"])
+        new = run("new", "check-error-centralization.py", parse_target, ["--error-profile", "auto"])
+        comparisons += 1
+        rows["error-centralization-tree-parse-fail"] = {
+            "old": old["code"], "new": new["code"],
+            "contains_analysis": b"[\xeb\xb6\x84\xec\x84\x9d]" in new["stdout"],
+        }
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff("error-centralization-tree-parse-fail", old, new)
+
+        # openapi repo_scan path without an application/<bc> tree, avoiding tree-slice interception.
+        repo_scan = td / "openapi-repo-scan"
+        write_tree(repo_scan, {
+            "src/orders/driving_layer/order_controller.py": (
+                "from ninja import Router\nrouter = Router()\n\n"
+                "@router.get('/', openapi_extra={'responses': {404: {'description': 'missing'}}})\n"
+                "def get_order(request):\n    return {'id': 1}\n"
+            )
+        })
+        old = run("old", "check-openapi-error-declaration.py", repo_scan, ["--error-profile", "auto"])
+        new = run("new", "check-openapi-error-declaration.py", repo_scan, ["--error-profile", "auto"])
+        comparisons += 1
+        rows["openapi-repo-scan"] = {
+            "old": old["code"], "new": new["code"], "repo_scan_header": b"openapi_extra" in new["stdout"]
+        }
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff("openapi-repo-scan", old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": "hidden", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "rows": rows}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["baseline", "record", "profiles", "errors", "paths", "anchor", "performance", "hidden"])
+    ns = parser.parse_args()
+    if ns.mode == "baseline":
+        baseline_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "record":
+        record_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "profiles":
+        profile_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "errors":
+        error_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "paths":
+        path_contract()
+    elif ns.mode == "anchor":
+        anchor_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "performance":
+        performance_probe()
+    else:
+        hidden_branch_matrix()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def copied(src: Path, parent: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest

+def baseline_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-baseline.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        bc_target = copied(FIX / "skeleton/good_bc/application/orders", td, "bc")
+        file_target = td / "target.py"
+        file_target.write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        nonexistent = td / "does-not-exist"
+        empty = td / "empty"
+        empty.mkdir()
+
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            green_sub = "good_bc" if lane == "skeleton" else "good"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            green = copied(FIX / lane / green_sub, td, f"green-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            cases = [
+                ("red", red, profile, None),
+                ("green", green, profile, None),
+                ("noargs", None, [], empty),
+                ("nonexistent", nonexistent, profile, None),
+                ("file_target", file_target, profile, None),
+                ("bc_shaped", bc_target, profile, None),
+                ("unknown_option", green, [*profile, "--not-a-real-option"], None),
+                ("help", green, ["--help"], None),
+            ]
+            for kind, target, extra, cwd in cases:
+                old = run("old", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                new = run("new", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "baseline", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))

+def record_matrix():
+    valid_changed = []
+    invalid_changed = []
+    readonly_dir_changed = []
+    readonly_file_changed = []
+    old_env_changed = []

+        td = Path(td_s)

+        ro_dir.chmod(0o555)
+        ro_dir_path = ro_dir / "records.jsonl"
+        ro_file = td / "readonly-file.jsonl"
+        ro_file.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
+        ro_file.chmod(0o444)
+        try:
+            for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+                red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+                red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+                profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+                unset_new = run("new", script, red, profile)
+                valid_path = td / f"{script}.jsonl"
+                set_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(valid_path)})
+                if not same(unset_new, set_new):
+                    valid_changed.append(script)
+                    emit_diff(f"record-valid:{script}", unset_new, set_new)
+                valid_record_counts[script] = len(valid_path.read_bytes().splitlines()) if valid_path.exists() else 0
+                bad_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+                if not same(unset_new, bad_new):
+                    invalid_changed.append(script)
+                ro_dir_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(ro_dir_path)})
+                if not same(unset_new, ro_dir_new):
+                    readonly_dir_changed.append(script)
+                ro_file_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(ro_file)})
+                if not same(unset_new, ro_file_new):
+                    readonly_file_changed.append(script)
+                unset_old = run("old", script, red, profile)
+                set_old = run("old", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+                if not same(unset_old, set_old):
+                    old_env_changed.append(script)
+        finally:
+            ro_dir.chmod(0o755)
+            ro_file.chmod(0o644)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "record",
+            "valid_stdout_stderr_exit_changed": valid_changed,
+            "invalid_path_changed_count": len(invalid_changed),
+            "invalid_path_changed": invalid_changed,
+            "readonly_dir_changed_count": len(readonly_dir_changed),
+            "readonly_file_changed_count": len(readonly_file_changed),
+            "old_env_changed": old_env_changed,
+            "valid_record_counts": valid_record_counts,
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+        script = "check-db-table.py"
+        red = td / f"red-{script}"
+        unset_old = run("old", script, red, [])
+        unset_new = run("new", script, red, [])
+        bad_new = run("new", script, red, [], {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+        emit_diff("representative-old-vs-new-unset", unset_old, unset_new)
+        emit_diff("representative-new-unset-vs-invalid-record", unset_new, bad_new)
+
+
+def write_tree(root: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+    for rel, source in files.items():
+        path = root / rel
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def compare_cases(cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]], summary: str) -> None:
+    diffs = 0
+    exits: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
+    for label, script, target, extra in cases:
+        old = run("old", script, target, extra)
+        new = run("new", script, target, extra)
+        exits[label] = [old["code"], new["code"]]
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff(label, old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": summary, "comparisons": len(cases), "diffs": diffs, "exits": exits}, ensure_ascii=False))
+

+def error_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-errors.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            source = FIX / lane / red_sub
+            for kind in ("syntax", "invalid_utf8", "unreadable_file", "unreadable_dir"):
+                target = copied(source, td, f"{kind}-{script}")
+                files = sorted(target.rglob("*.py"))
+                if not files:
+                    continue
+                chosen = files[0]
+                restore: Path | None = None
+                if kind == "syntax":
+                    chosen.write_text("def broken(:\n", encoding="utf-8")
+                elif kind == "invalid_utf8":
+                    chosen.write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\x00")
+                elif kind == "unreadable_file":
+                    chosen.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen
+                else:
+                    chosen.parent.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen.parent
+                try:
+                    old = run("old", script, target, profile)
+                    new = run("new", script, target, profile)
+                finally:
+                    if restore is not None:
+                        restore.chmod(0o755 if restore.is_dir() else 0o644)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "errors", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def load_module(path: Path, name: str):
+    previous = list(sys.path)
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(path.parent))
+    try:
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+        assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        sys.modules[name] = module
+        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+        return module
+    finally:
+        sys.path[:] = previous
+

+def path_contract():
+    os.environ.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)

+        Path(r"application\\orders\\models.py"),
+        PureWindowsPath(r"C:\\repo\\application\\orders\\models.py"),
+        Path("application/orders/model.py:27"),
+    ]
+    rows = []
+    for value in values:
+        old_f = old_mod.Findings()
+        old_f.add("#1", value, "message")
+        new_f = new_mod.Findings("check-db-table.py")
+        new_f.add("#1", value, "message")
+        rows.append({"input": repr(value), "old": list(old_f), "new": list(new_f), "same": list(old_f) == list(new_f)})
+    # Actual checker calls through Path values, with absolute and relative TARGET spelling.
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-paths.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        target = copied(FIX / "db_table/bad_rules", td, "fixture with space")
+        actual = []
+        for label, target_arg, cwd in (
+            ("absolute-target", target, None),
+            ("relative-target", Path("fixture with space"), td),
+        ):
+            old = run("old", "check-db-table.py", target_arg, [], cwd=cwd)
+            new = run("new", "check-db-table.py", target_arg, [], cwd=cwd)
+            actual.append({"label": label, "same": same(old, new), "old": describe(old), "new": describe(new)})
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": "path-contract", "direct": rows, "actual": actual}, ensure_ascii=False))

+GIT_ID = ["-c", "user.email=r-lane@example.invalid", "-c", "user.name=R Lane"]
+
+
+def git(repo: Path, *args: str):
+    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *GIT_ID, *args], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+
+
+def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
+    for args in (("add", "-A"), ("commit", "-q", "-m", message)):
+        proc = git(repo, *args)
+        if proc.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.decode().strip()
+
+
+def init_repo(dest: Path, source: Path) -> tuple[Path, str]:
+    shutil.copytree(source, dest)
+    proc = git(dest, "init", "-q")
+    if proc.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return dest, commit_all(dest, "anchor")
+
+
+def anchor_matrix():
+    specs = [
+        ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+        ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+        ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+        ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+        ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ]
+    cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]] = []
+    anchor_record = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-anchor.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for script, auto, lane in specs:
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            # bogus resolve on a clean green repository.
+            green_repo, _ = init_repo(td / f"bogus-{script}", FIX / lane / "good")
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-bogus", script, green_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", "deadbeef"]))
+            # vacuous diff: HEAD and clean.
+            vac_repo, vac_head = init_repo(td / f"vacuous-{script}", FIX / lane / "bad_rules")
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-vacuous", script, vac_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", vac_head]))
+            # all findings already at anchor; harmless dirty file makes diff non-vacuous.
+            existing_repo, existing_head = init_repo(td / f"existing-{script}", FIX / lane / "bad_rules")
+            (existing_repo / "harmless.txt").write_text("dirty\n", encoding="utf-8")
+            existing_args = [*profile, "--anchor", existing_head]
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-existing", script, existing_repo, existing_args))
+            # red material copied after green anchor: new findings.
+            new_repo, new_head = init_repo(td / f"new-{script}", FIX / lane / "good")
+            shutil.copytree(FIX / lane / "bad_rules", new_repo, dirs_exist_ok=True)
+            cases.append((f"{script}:anchor-new", script, new_repo, [*profile, "--anchor", new_head]))
+
+            # DJR channel is inherited by the baseline child. Compare output and count inflation.
+            plain_rec = td / f"plain-{script}.jsonl"
+            anchor_rec = td / f"anchor-{script}.jsonl"
+            plain = run("new", script, existing_repo, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(plain_rec)})
+            anchored = run("new", script, existing_repo, existing_args, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(anchor_rec)})
+            anchor_record[script] = {
+                "output_same_as_unset": same(run("new", script, existing_repo, existing_args), anchored),
+                "plain_count": len(plain_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()) if plain_rec.exists() else 0,
+                "anchor_count": len(anchor_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()) if anchor_rec.exists() else 0,
+                "plain_exit": plain["code"],
+                "anchor_exit": anchored["code"],
+            }
+
+        # analysis_pending=True: an anchor-existing tree finding plus dynamic error shape proof.
+        analysis_repo = td / "analysis-pending"
+        common_src = (
+            "from ninja import Schema\n\nclass FrameworkErrorSchema(Schema):\n"
+            "    code: str\n    title: str\n    status: int\n    detail: str\n"
+        )
+        dynamic_src = (
+            "from enum import StrEnum\n"
+            "from framework.ninja.framework_error_schema import FrameworkErrorSchema\n\n"
+            "_BASE = 'lesson'\n"
+            "class LessonErrorCode(StrEnum):\n"
+            "    _ignore_ = ['_BASE']\n"
+            "    _BASE = _BASE\n"
+            "    NOT_FOUND = f'{_BASE}_not_found'\n\n"
+            "class LessonErrorSchema(FrameworkErrorSchema):\n    code: LessonErrorCode\n"
+        )
+        write_tree(analysis_repo, {
+            "framework/ninja/framework_error_schema.py": common_src,
+            "application/lesson/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py": dynamic_src,
+            "application/lesson/driving_layer/controller.py": "def get_lesson(request): return {'id': 1}\n",
+            "application/report/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py": "",
+            "config/api.py": "from ninja_extra import NinjaExtraAPI\napi = NinjaExtraAPI()\n",
+        })
+        proc = git(analysis_repo, "init", "-q")
+        if proc.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+        analysis_head = commit_all(analysis_repo, "dynamic anchor")
+        (analysis_repo / "harmless.txt").write_text("dirty\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        analysis_args = [
+            "--error-profile", "dddjango-code-json", "--scope", "public-v1",
+            "--api-module", "config/api.py",

+def run_limited(script: str, target: Path, extra: list[str], env_add: dict[str, str], limit: int):
+    script_path = NEW / script
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    env.update(env_add)
+    def limit_fds():
+        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, (limit, limit))
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(script_path), str(target), *extra],
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, preexec_fn=limit_fds,
+    )
+    return {"code": proc.returncode, "stdout": proc.stdout, "stderr": proc.stderr, "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start}
+

+def performance_probe():
+    count = 8000
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-perf.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        target = td / "fixture"
+        controller = target / "application/orders/driving_layer/api/order/order_controller.py"
+        controller.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        (target / "application/orders/application_layer/order").mkdir(parents=True)
+        chunks = []
+        for i in range(count):
+            chunks.append(
+                f"def operation_{i}():\n"
+                "    try:\n        pass\n"
+                "    except Exception:\n        pass\n\n"
+            )
+        controller.write_text("".join(chunks), encoding="utf-8")
+        extra = ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+        measurements: dict[str, list[float]] = {"old-unset": [], "new-unset": [], "new-devnull": [], "new-file": []}
+        codes = {}
+        for round_no in range(4):
+            rec = td / f"records-{round_no}.jsonl"
+            variants = [
+                ("old-unset", lambda: run("old", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra)),
+                ("new-unset", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra)),
+                ("new-devnull", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": "/dev/null"})),
+                ("new-file", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(rec)})),
+            ]
+            # Rotate start position to reduce fixed ordering bias.
+            variants = variants[round_no:] + variants[:round_no]
+            for label, thunk in variants:
+                result = thunk()
+                measurements[label].append(result["elapsed"])
+                codes[label] = result["code"]
+        medians = {label: sorted(values)[len(values)//2] for label, values in measurements.items()}
+        limited_rec = td / "limited.jsonl"
+        limited = run_limited(
+            "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra,
+            {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(limited_rec)}, 16,
+        )
+        last_rec = td / "records-3.jsonl"
+        # round rotation means records-3 may or may not be last, but is written exactly once.
+        summary = {
+            "summary": "performance",
+            "findings": count,
+            "source_bytes": controller.stat().st_size,
+            "samples": {k: [round(x, 4) for x in v] for k, v in measurements.items()},
+            "medians": {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in medians.items()},
+            "file_vs_unset_ratio": round(medians["new-file"] / medians["new-unset"], 3),
+            "new_unset_vs_old_ratio": round(medians["new-unset"] / medians["old-unset"], 3),
+            "codes": codes,
+            "record_lines": len(last_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()),
+            "record_bytes": last_rec.stat().st_size,
+            "fd_limit_16": {"code": limited["code"], "stderr_n": len(limited["stderr"]), "record_lines": len(limited_rec.read_bytes().splitlines())},
+        }
+        print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False))
+

+            if case.baseline_files is not None:
+                matrix.initialize_git_fixture(target, case.baseline_files)
+            matrix.write_fixture(target, case.files)
+            args = [str(target) if arg == matrix.TARGET_DIR else arg for arg in case.checker_args]
+            # run() supplies target separately, so strip the positional TARGET_DIR expansion.
+            if args and args[0] == str(target):
+                args = args[1:]
+            old = run("old", case.checker, target, args)
+            new = run("new", case.checker, target, args)
+            comparisons += 1
+            rows[case.name] = {"old": old["code"], "new": new["code"], "expected": case.expected_exit}
+            if not same(old, new):
+                diffs += 1
+                emit_diff(case.name, old, new)
+
+        # error-centralization tree-slice parse-fail sentinel line.
+        parse_target = td / "parse-fail"
+        write_tree(parse_target, {
+            "application/orders/driving_layer/api/bc_error_schema.py": "def broken(:\n",
+        })
+        old = run("old", "check-error-centralization.py", parse_target, ["--error-profile", "auto"])
+        new = run("new", "check-error-centralization.py", parse_target, ["--error-profile", "auto"])
+        comparisons += 1
+        rows["error-centralization-tree-parse-fail"] = {
+            "old": old["code"], "new": new["code"],
+            "contains_analysis": b"[\xeb\xb6\x84\xec\x84\x9d]" in new["stdout"],
+        }
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff("error-centralization-tree-parse-fail", old, new)
+
+        # openapi repo_scan path without an application/<bc> tree, avoiding tree-slice interception.
+        repo_scan = td / "openapi-repo-scan"
+        write_tree(repo_scan, {
+            "src/orders/driving_layer/order_controller.py": (
+                "from ninja import Router\nrouter = Router()\n\n"
+                "@router.get('/', openapi_extra={'responses': {404: {'description': 'missing'}}})\n"
+                "def get_order(request):\n    return {'id': 1}\n"
+            )
+        })
+        old = run("old", "check-openapi-error-declaration.py", repo_scan, ["--error-profile", "auto"])
+        new = run("new", "check-openapi-error-declaration.py", repo_scan, ["--error-profile", "auto"])
+        comparisons += 1
+        rows["openapi-repo-scan"] = {
+            "old": old["code"], "new": new["code"], "repo_scan_header": b"openapi_extra" in new["stdout"]
+        }
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff("openapi-repo-scan", old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": "hidden", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "rows": rows}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def same_path_traceback_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-same-path.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        shared = td / "scripts"
+        shutil.copytree(OLD, shared)
+        target = copied(FIX / "usecase_dto/bad_rules", td, "fixture")
+        blocked = target / "application/orders/application_layer/order/cancel_order"
+        blocked.chmod(0)
+        try:
+            cmd = [sys.executable, str(shared / "check-usecase-dto-placement.py"), str(target)]
+            old = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+            shutil.copytree(NEW, shared, dirs_exist_ok=True)
+            new = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+        finally:
+            blocked.chmod(0o755)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "same-path-traceback",
+            "same": (old.returncode, old.stdout, old.stderr) == (new.returncode, new.stdout, new.stderr),
+            "old": {"code": old.returncode, "out_sha": digest(old.stdout), "err_sha": digest(old.stderr), "stderr": old.stderr.decode(errors="replace")},
+            "new": {"code": new.returncode, "out_sha": digest(new.stdout), "err_sha": digest(new.stderr), "stderr": new.stderr.decode(errors="replace")},
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["baseline", "record", "profiles", "errors", "paths", "anchor", "performance", "hidden", "samepath"])
+    ns = parser.parse_args()
+    if ns.mode == "baseline":
+        baseline_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "record":
+        record_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "profiles":
+        profile_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "errors":
+        error_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "paths":
+        path_contract()
+    elif ns.mode == "anchor":
+        anchor_matrix()
+    elif ns.mode == "performance":
+        performance_probe()
+    elif ns.mode == "hidden":
+        hidden_branch_matrix()
+    else:
+        same_path_traceback_probe()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def copied(src: Path, parent: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest

+                new = run("new", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)

+def write_tree(root: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+    for rel, source in files.items():
+        path = root / rel
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")

+def compare_cases(cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]], summary: str) -> None:
+    diffs = 0

+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff(label, old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": summary, "comparisons": len(cases), "diffs": diffs, "exits": exits}, ensure_ascii=False))

+def error_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-errors.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            source = FIX / lane / red_sub
+            for kind in ("syntax", "invalid_utf8", "unreadable_file", "unreadable_dir"):
+                target = copied(source, td, f"{kind}-{script}")
+                files = sorted(target.rglob("*.py"))
+                if not files:
+                    continue
+                chosen = files[0]
+                restore: Path | None = None
+                if kind == "syntax":
+                    chosen.write_text("def broken(:\n", encoding="utf-8")
+                elif kind == "invalid_utf8":
+                    chosen.write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\x00")
+                elif kind == "unreadable_file":
+                    chosen.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen
+                else:
+                    chosen.parent.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen.parent
+                try:
+                    old = run("old", script, target, profile)
+                    new = run("new", script, target, profile)
+                finally:
+                    if restore is not None:
+                        restore.chmod(0o755 if restore.is_dir() else 0o644)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "errors", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))

+def load_module(path: Path, name: str):
+    previous = list(sys.path)
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(path.parent))
+    try:
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+        assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        sys.modules[name] = module
+        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+        return module
+    finally:
+        sys.path[:] = previous
+

+GIT_ID = ["-c", "user.email=r-lane@example.invalid", "-c", "user.name=R Lane"]

+def git(repo: Path, *args: str):
+    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *GIT_ID, *args], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+
+
+def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
+    for args in (("add", "-A"), ("commit", "-q", "-m", message)):
+        proc = git(repo, *args)
+        if proc.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.decode().strip()
+
+
+def init_repo(dest: Path, source: Path) -> tuple[Path, str]:
+    shutil.copytree(source, dest)
+    proc = git(dest, "init", "-q")
+    if proc.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return dest, commit_all(dest, "anchor")

+def run_limited(script: str, target: Path, extra: list[str], env_add: dict[str, str], limit: int):
+    script_path = NEW / script
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    env.update(env_add)
+    def limit_fds():
+        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, (limit, limit))
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(script_path), str(target), *extra],
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, preexec_fn=limit_fds,
+    )
+    return {"code": proc.returncode, "stdout": proc.stdout, "stderr": proc.stderr, "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start}

+def performance_probe():
+    count = 8000

+                ("new-file", lambda: run("new", "check-api-error-controller-contract.py", target, extra, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(rec)})),
+            ]

+            variants = variants[round_no:] + variants[:round_no]
+            for label, thunk in variants:
+                result = thunk()

+                codes[label] = result["code"]

+        last_rec = td / "records-3.jsonl"
+        # round rotation means records-3 may or may not be last, but is written exactly once.
+        summary = {
+            "summary": "performance",
+            "findings": count,
+            "source_bytes": controller.stat().st_size,
+            "samples": {k: [round(x, 4) for x in v] for k, v in measurements.items()},
+            "medians": {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in medians.items()},
+            "file_vs_unset_ratio": round(medians["new-file"] / medians["new-unset"], 3),
+            "new_unset_vs_old_ratio": round(medians["new-unset"] / medians["old-unset"], 3),
+            "codes": codes,
+            "record_lines": len(last_rec.read_bytes().splitlines()),

+            "fd_limit_16": {"code": limited["code"], "stderr_n": len(limited["stderr"]), "record_lines": len(limited_rec.read_bytes().splitlines())},
+        }
+        print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False))

+def run(version: str, script: str, target: Path | None, extra: list[str] | None = None,
+        env_add: dict[str, str] | None = None, cwd: Path | None = None):
+    script_path = (OLD if version == "old" else NEW) / script
+    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)]
+    if target is not None:
+        cmd.append(str(target))
+    cmd.extend(extra or [])
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    if env_add:
+        env.update(env_add)
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+    return {
+        "code": proc.returncode,
+        "stdout": proc.stdout,
+        "stderr": proc.stderr,
+        "elapsed": time.perf_counter() - start,
+        "cmd": cmd,
+    }
+
+
+def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def describe(result):
+    return {
+        "code": result["code"],
+        "out_n": len(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_n": len(result["stderr"]),
+        "out_sha": digest(result["stdout"]),
+        "err_sha": digest(result["stderr"]),
+        "seconds": round(result["elapsed"], 4),
+    }
+
+
+def same(a, b):
+    return (a["code"], a["stdout"], a["stderr"]) == (b["code"], b["stdout"], b["stderr"])
+
+
+def emit_diff(label: str, a, b):
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "label": label,
+        "old": describe(a),
+        "new": describe(b),
+        "old_stdout": a["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stdout": b["stdout"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "old_stderr": a["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+        "new_stderr": b["stderr"].decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace")[:1200],
+    }, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+def copied(src: Path, parent: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    dest = parent / name
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest)
+    return dest
+
+
+def baseline_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-baseline.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        bc_target = copied(FIX / "skeleton/good_bc/application/orders", td, "bc")
+        file_target = td / "target.py"
+        file_target.write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        nonexistent = td / "does-not-exist"
+        empty = td / "empty"
+        empty.mkdir()
+
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            green_sub = "good_bc" if lane == "skeleton" else "good"
+            red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+            green = copied(FIX / lane / green_sub, td, f"green-{script}")
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            cases = [
+                ("red", red, profile, None),
+                ("green", green, profile, None),
+                ("noargs", None, [], empty),
+                ("nonexistent", nonexistent, profile, None),
+                ("file_target", file_target, profile, None),
+                ("bc_shaped", bc_target, profile, None),
+                ("unknown_option", green, [*profile, "--not-a-real-option"], None),
+                ("help", green, ["--help"], None),
+            ]
+            for kind, target, extra, cwd in cases:
+                old = run("old", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                new = run("new", script, target, extra, cwd=cwd)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "baseline", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))

+def record_matrix():
+    valid_changed = []
+    invalid_changed = []
+    readonly_dir_changed = []
+    readonly_file_changed = []
+    old_env_changed = []
+    valid_record_counts = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-record.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        invalid_path = td / "missing-parent" / "records.jsonl"
+        ro_dir = td / "readonly-dir"
+        ro_dir.mkdir()
+        ro_dir.chmod(0o555)
+        ro_dir_path = ro_dir / "records.jsonl"
+        ro_file = td / "readonly-file.jsonl"
+        ro_file.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
+        ro_file.chmod(0o444)
+        try:
+            for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+                red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+                red = copied(FIX / lane / red_sub, td, f"red-{script}")
+                profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+                unset_new = run("new", script, red, profile)
+                valid_path = td / f"{script}.jsonl"
+                set_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(valid_path)})
+                if not same(unset_new, set_new):
+                    valid_changed.append(script)
+                    emit_diff(f"record-valid:{script}", unset_new, set_new)
+                valid_record_counts[script] = len(valid_path.read_bytes().splitlines()) if valid_path.exists() else 0
+                bad_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+                if not same(unset_new, bad_new):
+                    invalid_changed.append(script)
+                ro_dir_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(ro_dir_path)})
+                if not same(unset_new, ro_dir_new):
+                    readonly_dir_changed.append(script)
+                ro_file_new = run("new", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(ro_file)})
+                if not same(unset_new, ro_file_new):
+                    readonly_file_changed.append(script)
+                unset_old = run("old", script, red, profile)
+                set_old = run("old", script, red, profile, {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+                if not same(unset_old, set_old):
+                    old_env_changed.append(script)
+        finally:
+            ro_dir.chmod(0o755)
+            ro_file.chmod(0o644)
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "summary": "record",
+            "valid_stdout_stderr_exit_changed": valid_changed,
+            "invalid_path_changed_count": len(invalid_changed),
+            "invalid_path_changed": invalid_changed,
+            "readonly_dir_changed_count": len(readonly_dir_changed),
+            "readonly_file_changed_count": len(readonly_file_changed),
+            "old_env_changed": old_env_changed,
+            "valid_record_counts": valid_record_counts,
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+        script = "check-db-table.py"
+        red = td / f"red-{script}"
+        unset_old = run("old", script, red, [])
+        unset_new = run("new", script, red, [])
+        bad_new = run("new", script, red, [], {"DJR_FINDINGS_JSON": str(invalid_path)})
+        emit_diff("representative-old-vs-new-unset", unset_old, unset_new)
+        emit_diff("representative-new-unset-vs-invalid-record", unset_new, bad_new)
+
+
+def write_tree(root: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+    for rel, source in files.items():
+        path = root / rel
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def compare_cases(cases: list[tuple[str, str, Path, list[str]]], summary: str) -> None:
+    diffs = 0
+    exits: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
+    for label, script, target, extra in cases:
+        old = run("old", script, target, extra)
+        new = run("new", script, target, extra)
+        exits[label] = [old["code"], new["code"]]
+        if not same(old, new):
+            diffs += 1
+            emit_diff(label, old, new)
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": summary, "comparisons": len(cases), "diffs": diffs, "exits": exits}, ensure_ascii=False))
+

+def error_matrix():
+    comparisons = 0
+    diffs = 0
+    by_case: dict[str, int] = {}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-errors.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        for script, auto, lane in REGISTRY:
+            red_sub = "bad_legacy_flat" if lane == "skeleton" else "bad_rules"
+            profile = ["--error-profile", "auto"] if auto else []
+            source = FIX / lane / red_sub
+            for kind in ("syntax", "invalid_utf8", "unreadable_file", "unreadable_dir"):
+                target = copied(source, td, f"{kind}-{script}")
+                files = sorted(target.rglob("*.py"))
+                if not files:
+                    continue
+                chosen = files[0]
+                restore: Path | None = None
+                if kind == "syntax":
+                    chosen.write_text("def broken(:\n", encoding="utf-8")
+                elif kind == "invalid_utf8":
+                    chosen.write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\x00")
+                elif kind == "unreadable_file":
+                    chosen.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen
+                else:
+                    chosen.parent.chmod(0)
+                    restore = chosen.parent
+                try:
+                    old = run("old", script, target, profile)
+                    new = run("new", script, target, profile)
+                finally:
+                    if restore is not None:
+                        restore.chmod(0o755 if restore.is_dir() else 0o644)
+                comparisons += 1
+                by_case[kind] = by_case.get(kind, 0) + 1
+                if not same(old, new):
+                    diffs += 1
+                    emit_diff(f"{script}:{kind}", old, new)
+        print(json.dumps({"summary": "errors", "comparisons": comparisons, "diffs": diffs, "by_case": by_case}, ensure_ascii=False))
+

+def load_module(path: Path, name: str):
+    previous = list(sys.path)
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(path.parent))
+    try:
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+        assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        sys.modules[name] = module
+        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+        return module
+    finally:
+        sys.path[:] = previous
+
+
+def path_contract():
+    os.environ.pop("DJR_FINDINGS_JSON", None)
+    old_mod = load_module(OLD / "check-db-table.py", "old_db_table_probe")
+    new_mod = load_module(NEW / "findings.py", "new_findings_probe")
+    from pathlib import PureWindowsPath
+    values = [
+        Path("application/orders/models.py"),
+        Path("../relative/with space.py"),
+        Path("/tmp/absolute/models.py"),
+        Path(r"application\\orders\\models.py"),
+        PureWindowsPath(r"C:\\repo\\application\\orders\\models.py"),
+        Path("application/orders/model.py:27"),
+    ]
+    rows = []
+    for value in values:
+        old_f = old_mod.Findings()
+        old_f.add("#1", value, "message")
+        new_f = new_mod.Findings("check-db-table.py")
+        new_f.add("#1", value, "message")
+        rows.append({"input": repr(value), "old": list(old_f), "new": list(new_f), "same": list(old_f) == list(new_f)})
+    # Actual checker calls through Path values, with absolute and relative TARGET spelling.
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dddjango-r-paths.") as td_s:
+        td = Path(td_s)
+        target = copied(FIX / "db_table/bad_rules", td, "fixture with space")
+        actual = []
+        for label, target_arg, cwd in (
+            ("absolute-target", target, None),
+            ("relative-target", Path("fixture with space"), td),
+        ):
+            old = run("old", "check-db-table.py", target_arg, [], cwd=cwd)
+            new = run("new", "check-db-table.py", target_arg, [], cwd=cwd)
+            actual.append({"label": label, "same": same(old, new), "old": describe(old), "new": describe(new)})
+    print(json.dumps({"summary": "path-contract", "direct": rows, "actual": actual}, ensure_ascii=False))

+GIT_ID = ["-c", "user.email=r-lane@example.invalid", "-c", "user.name=R Lane"]
+
+
+def git(repo: Path, *args: str):
+    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *GIT_ID, *args], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+
+
+def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
+    for args in (("add", "-A"), ("commit", "-q", "-m", message)):
+        proc = git(repo, *args)
+        if proc.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.decode().strip()
+
+
+def init_repo(dest: Path, source: Path) -> tuple[Path, str]:
+    shutil.copytree(source, dest)
+    proc = git(dest, "init", "-q")
+    if proc.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
+    return dest, commit_all(dest, "anchor")
+
